title: OPUSCAR 98 · 98 Years of Best Picture
note: One style per film. t0/dur: where the film sits in OPUSCAR 98 (seconds). render: 2D / 2.5D (3D models rendered into flat layers) / 3D; dim adds the tone (B&W, sepia). prompt_*: a reusable style prompt. shots: the cuts as they appear in the finished film.

styles.title: Wings
styles.style_zh: 默片 3D 空战 · 正色片黑白 + 琥珀染色
styles.desc_en: A three.js dogfight graded like a 1927 orthochromatic print: white skies, deep blacks, an amber tint, gate weave and scratches. Wings is remembered for aerial combat shot from cameras strapped to the planes, so most cameras here ride on the planes.
styles.desc_zh: 用 three.js 搭的一战空战，按 1927 年正色片拷贝调色：天空发白、黑位很深、整体琥珀染色、片门抖动和划痕。《翼》最出名的是把摄影机绑在飞机上拍的空战，所以这里大部分机位都装在飞机上。
styles.prompt_en: Smooth-shaded 3D graded as a silent-era orthochromatic print: high contrast, reds go black. Sky near-white, ground in readable mid-greys, deep blacks (25-35% of frame) only in silhouettes. Tint: blend whites half-way toward amber #FFCC80, so the sky is pale cream-amber, never solid orange; blacks stay black. Only the hero the story centres on keeps colour, whole figure at ~70% saturation (e.g. #D97757); every lamp, fire or other light source stays grey. 24 fps gate weave (±1 px), flicker (±5%), fine grain (±4%), 1-3 thin scratches, sparse dust, rounded corners, vignette; open on a 1 s iris. Signature shot: a camera rigged to something moving with the subject, rig in frame; then chase and POV. Cut every 2-3 s; white out through cloud, smoke or glare. Reference: William Wellman, *Wings* (1927). Avoid: motion blur, colour in the greys.
styles.prompt_zh: 平滑着色的 3D 按默片正色片拷贝调色：高反差，红色发黑。天空近白，地面留清楚的中灰层次，深黑占画面 25%–35%，只在剪影里。染色：白位向琥珀 #FFCC80 混一半，天空是淡奶油琥珀，不要整片橙；黑位不变。只有故事围绕的那个主角留色，整个人都留，饱和度约七成（如 #D97757）；灯火和其他光源一律是灰的。叠 24 fps 片门抖动（±1 像素）、闪烁（±5%）、细颗粒（±4%）、一到三条细划痕、稀疏灰尘，片门圆角加柔和暗角，第一镜 1 秒圆形光圈打开。招牌镜头：机位绑在跟主角一起动的东西上，露出一截支架，轻微震动；再接跟拍和主观镜头。每 2–3 秒一切，穿过云、烟或强光白场转场。对标 William Wellman《翼》（1927）。避免：运动模糊、灰阶里有颜色。
refs: RFC aerial photographs of the Somme, 1916–18

styles.title: The Broadway Melody
styles.style_zh: 黑金银装饰艺术歌舞海报
styles.desc_en: An Art Deco revue poster in black, gold and silver: airbrushed gradients, a stepped proscenium, a chrome condenser mic. It is 1929 Broadway at the height of Deco, and the film where sound arrives, so rings of sound pour out of the mic.
styles.desc_zh: 会动的黑金银装饰艺术歌舞海报：喷枪渐变、阶梯形台口、镀铬电容麦克风。1929 年的百老汇正是装饰艺术盛期，这部又是有声片降临的一部，所以让声波从麦克风里一圈圈放出来。
styles.prompt_en: Art Deco revue poster. Black lacquer ground; gold and silver from banded metallic gradients (3-5 hard bands); airbrush glows, sunbursts, ziggurat steps, streamlined curves; a stepped proscenium frame of gold lines and bulbs. Palette: ground #0A0908, gold #D6B560, highlight #F3E2A2, silver #BFC4C9; skin pale silver-cream; one saturated accent (e.g. #D97757) only on the hero the story centres on. Elongated Erté-style figures with real faces; fringe, sequins or feathers where the subject allows. Fine grain, glints, stars. Frontal symmetry, a central spotlight. Motion: chasing bulbs, a row of repeated elements (dancers, waves, columns) rippling toward the centre, rings radiating from the main sound or light source; slow pushes, cut on the music's beat (without music, every 2-3 s). References: A. M. Cassandre's posters, Erté's costumes. Avoid: flat yellow for metal, faceless figures, extra hues.
styles.prompt_zh: 装饰艺术歌舞海报。黑漆底；金和银都用分带金属渐变做（每个面 3–5 条硬分界），喷枪光晕、放射线、阶梯形、流线型，场景外圈套一道层层退进的金线台口框，嵌一排灯泡。色板按用途：底 #0A0908，金 #D6B560，高光 #F3E2A2，银 #BFC4C9；皮肤用淡银奶油色；只有故事围绕的那个主角用一个饱和强调色（如 #D97757）。人物是 Erté 式修长造型，有五官表情，题材允许时加流苏、亮片或羽毛。细颗粒、闪光点、星星。正面对称，中间一束追光。动起来：灯泡流动，一排重复元素（舞者、浪头）向中心卷成波浪，主要声源或光源放射环纹；镜头慢推，踩音乐的拍子切，无乐每 2–3 秒一切。对标 A. M. Cassandre 的海报、Erté 的服装设计。避免：平涂黄色冒充金属、人物没脸、多余的颜色。

styles.title: All Quiet on the Western Front
styles.desc_en: A woodcut after Käthe Kollwitz: big masses of black, white knife-cut contours, rough grain, with Clawd printed from its own orange block. Kollwitz's German anti-war prints of 1921–22 come from the same war and the same grief as the film.
styles.desc_zh: 珂勒惠支式木刻：大块的黑、刀刻的白轮廓、粗糙木纹，Clawd 用单独一块橙色版套印。珂勒惠支 1921–22 年的反战版画，和这部片出自同一场战争、同一种悲痛。
styles.prompt_en: Expressionist woodcut after Käthe Kollwitz, *Krieg* (1921-22). 60-70% solid black; white contour cuts 1/300-1/150 of frame width separate forms; faces are white shapes with a few black features; hands large. Figures fill the frame, cropped by its edges. Each cut tapers in and out with chipped edges, is wider the nearer it sits to the light, in slightly uneven bundles. Ink #17130F on paper #E8DFCA; texture is only wood-grain streaks and under-inked speckle (±5%). One colour block (e.g. #D97757) only on the hero the story centres on, flat on its body or clothes, cuts over it; black stays 60%+. Light enters through one opening (window, cloud gap); lamps get a short ring of cuts. The ground under figures stays uncut black. Quiet motion (breathing, a small gesture); slow pans and push-ins. Avoid: grey fog or midtones, even striped hatching, gore.
styles.prompt_zh: 仿凯绥·珂勒惠支《战争》组画（1921–22）的表现主义木刻。画面六到七成是实黑；形体之间用白色轮廓刀分开，刀宽为画幅宽的 1/300–1/150；人脸刻成白形，只留几笔黑五官；手要大。人物占满画面，被画框裁切。每刀都有尖的进刀收刀和碎木边，离光越近的刀越宽，刀痕成组排、节奏略不均。墨色 #17130F 印在 #E8DFCA 纸上；纹理只有木纹条和缺墨斑点（±5%）。只有故事围绕的那个主角套一块色版（如 #D97757），平铺在身体或衣服上，刀痕照样压在上面，黑仍占六成以上。光只从一个开口进来（窗、云缝）；灯只刻一小圈短刀痕。人物脚下的地面留不刻的黑。动作安静（呼吸、一个小手势）；慢摇、慢推。避免：灰雾灰调、排刀规整成条纹、血腥。

styles.title: Cimarron
styles.desc_en: A gold-toned albumen panorama of 1889: soft lens, a little pan blur, cream highlights and umber shadows, silver grain; only Clawd is hand-tinted. Cimarron opens on the 1889 land rush, so it is shot as a photograph of that year, keeping the chapter monochrome.
styles.desc_zh: 1889 年的金调色蛋白印相全景：柔焦、轻微的横向拖影、奶油高光和暖褐暗部、银盐颗粒，只有 Clawd 手工上色。片子开场就是 1889 年俄克拉何马圈地狂奔，用那一年的照片质感来拍，这一章也保持单色。
styles.prompt_en: A moving 1880s gold-toned albumen photograph. Paint soft-edged flat shapes by brightness: main subjects dark (15-30%), ground 50-60%, sky about 90%; visible hatching and grass tufts (lines ~1/300 of frame width). Then print: grayscale, slight blur (~1/800 of frame width), a faint smear of three horizontal offset copies growing with camera speed, multiply cream #F2DCB4, lift blacks to umber #2E1C0F, blotchy development (±5%), vignette to #785634, per-frame grain (±4%), dust, scratches. Hand-tint only the hero the story centres on (e.g. #D97757) as transparent dye, mask feathered 2-3 px; lamps stay sepia. Wide panorama: the middle band packed with repeated small elements (figures, animals, vehicles; for a lone subject fences, posts, trees), no big plane dominating. Camera: one 4-5 s ease-out pull back from the hero to the panorama. Avoid: hard ink outlines, colour beyond the hero, a flat grey print.
styles.prompt_zh: 会动的 1880 年代金调色蛋白照片。先画边缘柔和的平涂形，按亮度分：主体深（15%–30%），地面 50%–60%，天空约 90%；物面和草丛有看得见的排线（线宽约画幅宽 1/300）。再“印”：转灰度，轻柔焦（约画幅宽 1/800），三层横向错开的淡影随运镜拉长，乘奶油色 #F2DCB4，黑位抬成暖褐 #2E1C0F，显影不匀（±5%），暗角压到 #785634，每帧刷新颗粒（±4%），稀疏灰尘划痕。只给故事围绕的那个主角手工上色（如 #D97757），像透明染料，蒙版羽化 2–3 像素；灯光仍是棕褐。横向全景，中间一条带排满重复小元素：人物、动物、车辆，题材冷清就用篱笆、木桩、树；别让一整块大面占满画面。天空默认发白。运镜：从主角近景 4–5 秒缓出拉到全景。避免：硬墨线、主角以外的颜色、干净的数码天空、发灰的印相。

styles.title: Grand Hotel
styles.style_zh: 米高梅银色黑白 3D 大堂
styles.desc_en: A three.js model of the circular lobby, graded in MGM's silver black and white with Clawd's orange as the only colour. The film's best-known image is the shot straight down the well, galleries closing in rings, so the set is built around it.
styles.desc_zh: 用 three.js 建的圆形大堂，按米高梅的银色黑白调色，Clawd 的橙是唯一的颜色。这部片最出名的是从顶上笔直往下拍、回廊一圈圈收进去的镜头，整个布景就按这一镜来建。
styles.prompt_en: A real 3D set, by default an Art Deco interior (marble, chrome, chandelier, glossy checkerboard floor); outdoors keep the real setting with glossy surfaces (wet pavement, still water) and symmetrical framing. Ambient occlusion, soft bloom; 1930s studio silver: about 40% deep black, glossy whites near 90%, no washed-out greys. Light falls in shafts from one high source. All neutral grey except the hero the story centres on (e.g. #D97757), at least 1/6 of frame height; warm lamps render white, bloom only around them. Grain (±3%), halation. Signature shot: eye-height wide into a deep symmetrical set, floor and ceiling in frame, floor reflections; then 4-6 s tracks; one overhead on rings, figures as chess pieces. Period figures (heads, hats, limbs) walk routes. References: art director Cedric Gibbons, cinematographer William Daniels. Avoid: walking in place, frame-filling abstract patterns, colour casts.
styles.prompt_zh: 真 3D 场景，默认装饰艺术风大堂（大理石、镀铬、吊灯、亮面棋盘格地面）；室外保留真实场景，表面做出光泽（湿路面、静水），构图对称。环境光遮蔽加柔和辉光，调成 30 年代片厂银色黑白：约四成画面深黑，白位亮度约九成，不发灰。光从一个高处光源成束落下。只有故事围绕的那个主角留色（如 #D97757），至少占画面高度六分之一；暖灯渲染成白光，辉光只在灯旁。颗粒（±3%），灯旁光晕。招牌镜头：平视大全景，望进对称纵深，地面和天花同时入画，地面有倒影；再接 4–6 秒的侧向跟拍；俯拍同心圆、人像棋子只用一次。年代人物有头、帽、四肢，按路线走。对标美术指导 Cedric Gibbons、摄影师 William Daniels。避免：原地踏步、抽象图案铺满画面、偏色。

styles.title: Cavalcade
styles.desc_en: A Mucha-style Art Nouveau panel: swelling brown outlines, pastel flats, a mosaic ground and a halo behind the central figure. Cavalcade opens on New Year's Eve 1899 with a family toasting the new century, so the halo is a clock striking twelve.
styles.desc_zh: 慕夏式新艺术装饰画：膨胀的褐色轮廓线、粉彩平涂、马赛克底，中心人物身后一个光环。电影开场就是 1899 年跨年夜一家人举杯迎接新世纪，所以光环做成敲十二点的钟面。
styles.prompt_en: Alphonse Mucha colour lithograph. Brown contours #4B3326, about 1/250 of frame width, doubling on the shadow side (light from upper left), tapered ends; pastel flats, each with a hard-edged darker shadow tone. Palette: cream #F5ECD6 paper/sky, sage #A9B490 foliage/drapery, pale gold #CFA55A halo/ornament, rose #DBA49C skin/flowers; the hero the story centres on in one stronger accent (e.g. #D97757). Wide frame: figure and a big ring-filled halo in the middle third, arched panels either side, behind them a muted-teal (sage plus grey) square-tile mosaic; whiplash vines, local flowers; a bottom band of serif capitals in the user's language, 1/25 of frame height. No plain area over 1/8 of frame. Almond eyes, heavy lids; hair or cloth in three-tone strands. Litho grain, paper mottle, vignette. Slow sway; tilt down to the halo, pull back. Avoid: thin clean lines, saturated colour, empty backgrounds.
styles.prompt_zh: 慕夏式彩色石印。褐色 #4B3326 轮廓线，宽约画幅宽 1/250，背光侧（光默认从左上来）加粗到两倍，两端收尖；粉彩平涂，每块在背光侧叠一层深一档的硬边色。色板：奶油 #F5ECD6 作纸和天空，鼠尾草绿 #A9B490 作植物衣褶，淡金 #CFA55A 作光环装饰，玫瑰 #DBA49C 作皮肤和花；故事围绕的那个主角用一个更浓的强调色（如 #D97757）。横幅：人物和细环纹大光环居中三分之一，两侧拱格，后面铺灰青（鼠尾草绿掺灰）方块马赛克；鞭线藤蔓和花草；底部一条衬线大写铭文，用用户语言，字高约画面 1/25。留白不超过画面八分之一。杏仁眼、厚眼睑；头发或衣料三色成束。石版颗粒、纸斑、暗角。慢摆；下摇到光环再拉远。避免：干净细线、饱和色、空荡背景。

styles.title: It Happened One Night
styles.desc_en: A 1934 black-and-white rubber-hose cartoon: thick-thin ink, pie-cut eyes, white gloves, cel shading over grey watercolour backgrounds, with film grain. It is the film's own year, and a road comedy gag suits cartoon timing.
styles.desc_zh: 1934 年的黑白橡皮管卡通：粗细变化的墨线、饼切眼、白手套，赛璐璐平涂叠在灰阶水彩背景上，带胶片颗粒。和电影同一年，公路喜剧的笑点也适合卡通的节奏。
styles.prompt_en: Early-1930s black-and-white rubber-hose cartoon. Characters: noodle limbs, white gloves, pie-cut eyes, round heads; thick-thin ink #141414 (1/400-1/150 of frame width) swelling away from the light (default upper left); fills pure black and white plus at most one light grey for the hard shadow, gloss on blacks. Backgrounds stay mid-grey (30-80%), never pure black/white: graphite lines left in, grey watercolour washes with pooled edges and granulation, paper grain. Only the hero the story centres on has colour (e.g. #D97757): its whole body, or its one key prop if the hero is human. ±1 px gate weave, grain (±4%), flicker, scratches, dust. Actions anticipate, overshoot, settle: squash on landing, stretch on fast moves, eyes pop when surprised, a camera jolt on hits. References: Fleischer's Betty Boop shorts; Disney's Silly Symphonies backgrounds. Avoid: smooth vector lines, grey characters merging with the background.
styles.prompt_zh: 30 年代初的黑白橡皮管卡通。角色：软管四肢、白手套、饼切眼、圆脑袋，三到四头身；墨线 #141414 粗细变化（画幅宽 1/400–1/150），背光一侧变粗（默认光从左上）；角色平涂只用纯黑、纯白，加至多一种浅灰作硬阴影，黑面一道高光。背景只用中间灰（明度 30%–80%），不用纯黑白：铅笔线不擦，灰色水彩罩染，边缘积水有颗粒沉淀。只有故事围绕的那个主角带颜色（如 #D97757）：整个身体，主角是人时只给关键道具。加 ±1 像素片门抖动、24 fps 颗粒（±4%）、闪烁、划痕、灰尘。动作都有预备、冲过头再回落：落地压扁、快动拉长、吃惊时弹眼，碰撞时镜头轻震。对标弗莱舍工作室的 Betty Boop 短片、迪士尼《糊涂交响曲》的背景。避免：光滑矢量线、角色发灰和背景糊在一起。

styles.title: Mutiny on the Bounty
styles.desc_en: An 18th-century Admiralty sea chart engraved in copperplate, with rhumb lines, compass roses, soundings and thin hand colour; the Bounty is a ship vignette on the sheet. The film is a voyage, so the whole film stays on the chart.
styles.desc_zh: 18 世纪英国海军部海图的铜版画：恒向线、罗盘玫瑰、水深数字、手工淡彩，邦蒂号是图上的一幅船舶插画。这部片讲的是一次航行，所以整段都留在海图上。
styles.prompt_en: A late-18th-century copperplate map, default an Admiralty sea chart (inland: a survey map). Fine burin hatching and cross-hatching (lines ~1/1200 of frame width) give all tone; a minimum line width makes small detail darken, not vanish. Ink #1C1610 on laid paper #EFE3C4, light foxing, folds. Thin hand colour: water #9EBCBC along edges, land #B8C08C; the hero the story centres on (e.g. #D97757) is the one strong colour. Rhumb lines from 32-point roses, a graduated border, hachured hills, cartouche, one ornament (e.g. a sea monster), serif lettering. Put the action in an unboxed engraved vignette fading into the chart, filling 60-75% of frame height at the end of the move. Camera: one 5-6 s glide from the whole sheet into the vignette, chart still around it; a dotted route inks itself in. Avoid: cropping the paper, heavy washes, stiff figures.
styles.prompt_zh: 18 世纪末的铜版地图，默认是英国海军部海图（内陆题材换成测绘图）。明暗全靠刻刀细排线和交叉排线，线宽约画幅宽的 1/1200；线宽设下限，细小处变暗而不是消失。墨色 #1C1610 印在 #EFE3C4 直纹纸上，带淡霉斑和折痕。只上很薄的手工淡彩：沿水边的海蓝 #9EBCBC，陆地 #B8C08C；故事围绕的那个主角（如 #D97757）是唯一的浓色。32 向罗盘玫瑰拉出恒向线网、刻度边框、晕滃山形、装饰图名框、一个装饰物（如海怪）、衬线字。情节放进一幅不加边框的排线插画，排线向纸面渐隐；推到底时插画占画面高度 60%–75%。运镜：一个 5–6 秒的镜头从整张图滑进插画，四周留着地图；一条虚线路线自己画出来。避免：切出纸面、浓重水彩、僵硬的人物。
refs: Robert Dodd, The Mutineers turning Lieut. Bligh… adrift (1790)

styles.title: The Great Ziegfeld
styles.style_zh: 银色黑白 3D 螺旋婚礼蛋糕舞台
styles.desc_en: A three.js model of the revolving spiral 'wedding cake' stage in MGM's silver black and white: satin, chiffon and ostrich feathers against deep black, Clawd the only colour. The 175-step spiral of 'A Pretty Girl Is Like a Melody' is the film's famous set piece.
styles.desc_zh: 用 three.js 建的旋转螺旋“婚礼蛋糕”舞台，米高梅银色黑白：缎面、雪纺和鸵鸟羽毛衬在深黑里，只有 Clawd 是颜色。《A Pretty Girl Is Like a Melody》那座 175 级的螺旋舞台是这部片的名场面。
styles.prompt_en: Real 3D stage spectacle in 1930s studio silver: the subject's world built as a revue set on a round tiered platform turning about 3° per second, draped and garlanded; its people become rows of costumed chorus figures with faces and arms. Costumes light satin grey, set mid-grey, pleated curtain backdrop darker, theatre deep black; whites below pure white. Soft front key; brighter rim lights edging satin and feathers near-white. Faint shafts, grain (±3%). All neutral grey except the hero the story centres on (e.g. #D97757); lamps render white. Signature shot: low medium along the tiers, figures 1/4-1/3 of frame height, the hero on the front tier. Then a 3 s curtain rise, a 10 s crane up to a level medium of the hero. Reference: Robert Z. Leonard, *The Great Ziegfeld* (1936). Avoid: flat lighting, faceless cones, fast spinning.
styles.prompt_zh: 真 3D 舞台大场面，调成 30 年代片厂银色黑白：把题材的世界搭成圆形分层转台上的歌舞布景，慢慢转（每秒约 3 度），挂满垂幔花环；题材里的人变成一排排穿戏服、有脸有手的合唱队。灰阶：戏服浅缎灰，布景中灰，褶皱大幕更深，剧场深黑；白色不到纯白。正面柔和主光，轮廓光更亮，把缎子和羽毛的边勾到近白。淡光柱，颗粒（±3%）。只有故事围绕的那个主角留色（如 #D97757），灯都渲染成白光。招牌镜头：贴低的中景沿层台看过去，人物占画面高度四分之一到三分之一，主角在前排。再接帷幕升起（3 秒）、10 秒吊臂上升，落到平视主角的中景。对标 Robert Z. Leonard《歌舞大王齐格飞》（1936）。避免：平均打光、没脸的锥形人、转得太快。
refs: Cedric Gibbons and John Harkrider (sets and costumes)
Oliver T. Marsh, Ray June, George Folsey (cinematography)

styles.title: The Life of Emile Zola
styles.style_zh: 报纸活字印刷 + 线刻插图
styles.desc_en: Letterpress newsprint with 1890s line engraving: a wood-type headline, dense columns of lead type, ink spread and under-inking on yellowed paper, figures in hatching. The film's best-known image is L'Aurore's 'J'Accuse…!' front page of 13 January 1898.
styles.desc_zh: 报纸活字印刷加 1890 年代线刻插图：木活字大标题、密排铅字正文，泛黄新闻纸上的油墨外扩和缺墨，人物用排线画。这部片最有名的画面就是 1898 年 1 月 13 日《震旦报》的《我控诉》头版。
styles.prompt_en: 1890s newspaper print. Set text as a sharp mask, then print: ~1 px blur and a noisy threshold for ink spread, ragged edges, under-inked patches, faint mirrored show-through. Page grammar: masthead, a wood-type headline across the width (~1/6 of frame height), 3-6 columns of small type in the user's language (~1/80 of frame height) flanking one large engraved picture. Wood-type letters are grained blocks. Everything pictured is a line engraving: hatching lines about 1/1000 of frame width, spaced 1/400, following the form, cross-hatching only in darks, heavier shadow-side contours, paler distance. Warm black #17130F on newsprint #E8E0CC; the hero the story centres on gets one accent plate (e.g. #D97757), offset 1-2 px. Motion: type blocks slam down, bounce and leave their print; one repeating mechanical motion, pages turning. Avoid: clean digital type, smooth grey shading, other colours.
styles.prompt_zh: 1890 年代的报纸印刷。文字先排成清晰墨版再“印”：约 1 像素模糊加噪声阈值切边，做出油墨外扩、字边毛糙、局部缺墨、淡淡的背面镜像透字。版面语法：报头、横贯全宽的木活字大标题（约画面高度 1/6）、3–6 栏小字正文（用用户的语言，字高约画面 1/80）夹着一幅大线刻插图。木活字一字一块，带木纹。所有画面都是线刻：线宽约画幅宽 1/1000、间距约 1/400，顺着形体走，交叉排线只用在暗部，背光一侧轮廓加粗，远处用淡墨。暖黑 #17130F 印在新闻纸 #E8E0CC 上；故事围绕的那个主角单独一块强调色版（如 #D97757），套印偏 1–2 像素。动起来：活字块砸下、回弹、留下印迹；一个反复的机械动作，报纸翻页。避免：干净的数码字体、平滑灰调、其他颜色。
refs: Le Petit Journal and L'Illustration line engravings

styles.title: You Can't Take It with You
styles.desc_en: A 1930s WPA silkscreen poster: six flat opaque inks, split-fountain gradients, slight misregistration on rag paper. The Federal Art Project posters of 1936–39 were American graphic design of the film's own years, and they keep it apart from No. 10's newsprint.
styles.desc_zh: 30 年代 WPA 丝网海报：六色不透明平涂油墨、分色渐变、轻微套印错位，印在棉浆纸上。1936–39 年联邦艺术计划的海报就是这部片同年代的美国平面语言，也和第 10 部的报纸拉开距离。
styles.prompt_en: A 1936-39 WPA (Federal Art Project) silkscreen poster. Six opaque inks printed light to dark, each later screen cut away around lighter shapes (clouds, sun): cream #F0E2C0 for light, ochre #E0A842 and vermilion #C84A2A for sky and warm planes, teal #22686E for water and shade, the hero's own ink (e.g. #D97757, only on the hero the story centres on), brown keyline #322018 last. Shadows: a darker ink overprinted, never grey. Big areas get split-fountain blends: two inks in 2-3 coarse steps, the middle one their overprint. Screens 1-3 px off register; wandering stencil edges, squeegee streaks, warm rag-paper grain (±5%) on every flat. Figures fill 1/2-2/3 of frame height: big planes, crescent shadows, expressive faces. A bold capital title band, user's language. Slow pushes; screens pop in one by one. Avoid: halftone dots, smooth gradients, clean vector flats.
styles.prompt_zh: 1936–39 年 WPA 联邦艺术计划的丝网海报。六色不透明油墨从浅到深套印，后印的版要在不该盖住的浅色形（云、太阳、高光）处镂空：奶油 #F0E2C0 给光和云，赭 #E0A842、朱红 #C84A2A 给天空和暖色面，青 #22686E 给水和阴影，主角专用色（如 #D97757，只用在故事围绕的那个主角身上），最后印深棕描边 #322018。阴影是深一色叠印，不用灰。大面积用分色渐变：两色 2–3 级粗台阶，中间一级是两色叠印。每版套偏 1–3 像素，模版边缘游移，刮板拖痕、漏印，平涂上都有暖色棉浆纸纹（±5%）。人物占画面高度二分之一到三分之二：大块面、月牙形暗面、棕色描边、脸有表情。留一条粗体大写标题，用用户的语言。慢推，一版一版弹出来。避免：网点、平滑渐变、干净的矢量平涂。
refs: WPA Federal Art Project silkscreen posters, 1936–39

styles.title: Gone with the Wind
styles.desc_en: Impasto oil with palette-knife slabs, ridged paint and Technicolor heat: skies burning from gold to blood red, red earth, black silhouettes. Gone with the Wind is where colour arrives in the film, so Tara at sunset is the first fully saturated frame.
styles.desc_zh: 厚涂油画：刮刀色块、颜料堆起的棱，Technicolor 的热度——从金色烧到血红的天空、红土、黑色剪影。全片的色彩从《乱世佳人》开始降临，第一张满色画面就是夕阳下的塔拉。
styles.prompt_en: Impasto oil in a 1939 Technicolor palette. Palette-knife slabs: long horizontal sky bands (1/15-1/6 of frame width long, about 1/60 tall), shorter strokes following form on land and figures, calm thin areas between; ridges lit from upper left, paint thickest in highlights, canvas weave where thin. Default sunset sky: wine #3A0912, red #A8241A, orange #F27A22, gold #FFD878; ground red-brown #6E2214; warm near-black silhouettes. The hero the story centres on stays a readable warm mid-tone (e.g. #D97757), never a silhouette. Strong backlight, gold rims; in close shots a warm side light on half the face and hands. Epic-poster composition: big dark silhouettes (trees, buildings, rocks, figures) on a low horizon. Lamps as painted flames. Camera: slow push on the wide, low push-in on the hero, crane up to a vista. Avoid: tiled same-size strokes, muddy browns, smooth gradients.
styles.prompt_zh: 1939 年 Technicolor 配色的厚涂油画。刮刀色块：天空用长条横向色带（长为画幅宽的 1/15–1/6，厚约 1/60），地面和人物用顺形体的短笔触，之间留出平静、薄涂的区域；颜料棱受左上方的光，越亮越厚，薄处露布纹。默认是落日天空，从酒红 #3A0912 经大红 #A8241A、橙 #F27A22 烧到金 #FFD878；地面红褐 #6E2214；剪影是带暖意的近黑；故事围绕的那个主角保持看得清的暖中间调（如 #D97757），不做成剪影。强逆光，金色轮廓光；近景加一道暖色侧光照亮半边脸和手。构图像史诗海报：大块深色剪影（树、房子、岩石、人物）压在低地平线上。灯火用油画火焰。运镜：全景慢推，低机位推近主角，最后吊臂升起看大景。避免：大小一样的碎块铺满画面、脏棕色、平滑渐变。
refs: Ernest Haller and Ray Rennahan (Technicolor cinematography)

styles.title: Rebecca
styles.desc_en: Charcoal on toothed paper: velvet blacks, smudged greys, moonlight and mist lifted out with an eraser. Hitchcock's Rebecca is a black-and-white Gothic dream of a house in mist and then in flames, and charcoal can draw both.
styles.desc_zh: 粗纹纸上的炭笔画：天鹅绒般的黑、抹开的灰，月光和雾用橡皮擦出来。希区柯克的《蝴蝶梦》是一场黑白哥特梦，庄园先在雾里、后在火里，炭笔两样都画得出来。
styles.prompt_en: Charcoal on toothed paper. Fine tooth (grain ~1/600 of frame width): light pressure catches only the peaks, heavy pressure fills the valleys. Grain only in midtones; velvet blacks, clean-paper lifts. Values: ~60% dark-to-mid grey, 15% deep black in the nearest foreground and largest masses, lights small. Charcoal #121111 on paper #EEECE7. Marks: broken vine lines, side-of-the-stick sweeps (1/60-1/30 of frame width) following form, hatching, finger smudges, eraser lifts for edges and glows; mist is horizontal streaks erased out of a toned area (as in William Kentridge's animated drawings). Only the hero the story centres on is in pastel (e.g. #D97757), laid fairly solid, tooth peeking through, outlined in charcoal; flames stay charcoal-and-paper. Moonlight from above; 2-3 fog bands drift at different speeds. Camera: slow subjective push, foreground parting. Avoid: digital noise, smooth digital glows, grey blacks, empty bright skies.
styles.prompt_zh: 有纹的纸上画炭笔。纸纹细（颗粒约画幅宽 1/600）：轻压只挂纹峰，重压填满纹谷。颗粒只在中间调；黑如天鹅绒，擦白是干净纸面。明暗：约六成画面暗到中灰，一成半深黑，在最近的前景和最大块面上，亮处少。炭色 #121111，纸色 #EEECE7。笔法：藤炭干笔断线，炭条侧锋顺形体宽扫（宽为画幅宽 1/60–1/30），排线，手指抹，橡皮擦出边光和光晕；雾是在铺好的灰调上横向擦出来的（如 William Kentridge 的动画素描）。只有故事围绕的那个主角用粉彩（如 #D97757），铺得较实、透点纸纹，炭笔勾边；火焰保持炭黑和纸白。月光从上方来，两三层雾带不同速横漂。运镜：主观镜头慢推，前景向两边分开。避免：数码噪点、光滑的数码光晕、发灰的黑、空亮的天空。

styles.title: How Green Was My Valley
styles.desc_en: Opaque gouache in the 1941 poster's gold and green: solid colour masses, coal-black tips, Kyffin Williams' heavy dark hills and broken contours. It replaced a woodcut that repeated No. 3; the scene is the colliers walking home down the valley, singing.
styles.desc_zh: 用 1941 年原海报金黄加绿配色的不透明水粉：扎实的色块、煤黑的渣山、Kyffin Williams 式厚重的深色山体和断续描边。原定的木刻和第 3 部重复，改成水粉；画的是矿工唱着歌走下山谷回家。
styles.prompt_en: Opaque gouache after Welsh painter Kyffin Williams. Directional strokes 1/80-1/40 of frame width, 2-5 times as long, ragged, fully covering; broken dark dashes outline buildings, walls and ridges; dark hills flecked with lighter green or slate knife marks. Palette: sky and light pale gold #F1C565 (not mustard), fields green #86A03F, darks coal #1D1B1E, far hills and water slate #48505E, small accents yellow #F6CF2F, other colours mixed from these; the hero the story centres on #D97757, at least 1/8 of frame height. Fields and sky light (~60%), hills and buildings dark. Warm grade under 10%, vignette, grain. Default low late-afternoon side light: fields lit, ridges rim-lit. From high ground in true perspective, a path leading the eye down; small repeated buildings (or walls, rocks) stepping along slopes. Motion: looping smoke or cloud, a lateral track. Avoid: watercolour transparency, vector fills, mud.
styles.prompt_zh: 仿威尔士画家 Kyffin Williams 的不透明水粉。方向性笔触宽为画幅宽 1/80–1/40，长是宽的 2–5 倍，边缘毛糙，完全覆盖；房子、墙、山脊用断续深色短线勾边；暗山上刮几笔亮绿或灰蓝。色板：天空和光淡金 #F1C565（别成芥末黄），田野绿 #86A03F，暗部煤黑 #1D1B1E，远山和水面灰蓝 #48505E，小点缀黄 #F6CF2F，其他颜色由这几色调出；故事围绕的那个主角用 #D97757，至少占画面高八分之一。田野和天空偏亮（约六成），山和房子偏暗。暖色调色不超过一成，暗角，颗粒。默认傍晚低角度侧光，田野受光，山脊有轮廓光。从高处真透视取景，一条路把视线引下去；小房子（或墙、石块）顺山坡一级级排开。动起来：烟或云循环飘动，横向跟拍。避免：水彩透明感、矢量平涂、发暗发脏。

styles.title: Mrs. Miniver
blend_en: Stone lithograph with crayon shadow plate
Frank Newbould and Abram Games WWII posters
blend_zh: Frank Newbould、Abram Games 二战海报
styles.desc_en: A WWII British Home Front lithograph poster: flat brick red, deep green, cream and grey-blue, with a grainy crayon shadow plate. It fits the film's last scene, a village singing in its bombed church while Spitfires pass overhead.
styles.desc_zh: 二战英国本土战线的石印海报：砖红、深绿、奶油、灰蓝的有限套色，阴影是石版蜡笔颗粒。配影片结尾：被炸穿屋顶的乡村教堂里全村唱诗，喷火式战机从破洞上方飞过。
styles.prompt_en: A 1942 British wartime stone-lithograph poster. Simple, strong shapes from three plates, 1-3 px off register: a colour plate with all flat fills; a grey-blue crayon plate darkening every shadow with short slanted stone grain; a green-black key line about 1/500 of frame width around every shape, figures and clouds included. Palette by role: cream #EBDFC2 paper and highlights, grey-blue #8497A6 sky and shadow, brick red #A23F2D and deep green #34503F as accents, at most a quarter of the frame; browns and skin mixed from cream and brick; key #1E2422. Scenes may be full. Airbrushed skies; only the paper grain boils at 12 fps. Pale light bands, angled from the source, cancel the shadow plate. Figures stand frontally. Camera: slow drifts, a tilt up. References: Frank Newbould, Abram Games. Avoid: dot screens, clean vector edges, big saturated fields.
styles.prompt_zh: 做成 1942 年英国战时的石印海报。造型简化有力，三版套印，略错位 1–3 像素：色版承载所有平涂；冷灰蓝蜡笔版压暗每一处阴影，带短而斜的石纹颗粒（不用网点）；墨绿黑轮廓版给每个形描一圈约画幅宽 1/500 的线，人物和云也要描。配色按用途：奶油 #EBDFC2 是纸色和亮部，灰蓝 #8497A6 是天空和阴影，砖红 #A23F2D 和深绿 #34503F 只作点缀，合计不超过画面四分之一；棕色和肤色由奶油加砖红调出；轮廓色 #1E2422。场景可以排满。天空用喷枪渐变，只有纸纹每秒 12 帧跳动。浅色光带顺着光源方向斜落，照到之处阴影版消失。人物正面站立，像海报里的人。镜头慢移带视差、上摇。对标 Frank Newbould、Abram Games。避免：网点阴影、干净的矢量边、大片饱和色。
refs: Frank Newbould, Your Britain — Fight for it Now (1942)

styles.title: Casablanca
styles.desc_en: The film's own look, Arthur Edeson's studio black-and-white, painted as a retouched glamour still: rich greys, soft-focus close-ups with catchlights, venetian-blind shadows, light shafts in smoke and fog. Clawd, as Rick, is the only colour.
styles.desc_zh: 影片本身的样子：Arthur Edeson 的片厂黑白，画成精修剧照：带眼神光的柔焦特写、百叶窗投影、烟雾里的光柱。扮里克的 Clawd 是唯一的颜色。
styles.prompt_en: 1940s Hollywood studio black-and-white, painted like a retouched glamour still. Forms: smooth airbrushed tone blocks. Faces: short key (light on the face's far side from camera; the near cheek in shadow, holding a Rembrandt triangle of light), two catchlights per eye. Slatted shadows from anything at hand (blinds, railings, branches) fall diagonally across surfaces; light shafts show only in smoke or fog. Values: 30-40% of the frame deep black, whites small and glowing; outdoor skies mid-dark. Grade: diffusion glow, an S-curve, fine grain (±3%), soft vignette, faint flicker; fog stays local. Only the hero the story centres on keeps colour, on its body or costume (e.g. #D97757); skin and lamps stay grey. Camera: a long glide, a push to a face, a pull-back into fog. References: cinematographer Arthur Edeson (*Casablanca*, Michael Curtiz, 1942). Avoid: flat lighting, grey haze, stiff busts.
styles.prompt_zh: 40 年代好莱坞片厂黑白，画成精修剧照。形体是边缘干净的喷枪明暗块。人脸用短光位：主光照亮离镜头远的那半边脸，靠近镜头的脸颊落在暗部，留一块伦勃朗三角光；每只眼两个眼神光。条状影子借手边的东西（百叶窗、栏杆、树枝），斜落在物面上；光柱只在烟雾飘过处显形。明暗：三到四成画面是深黑，白色面积小而发光；外景天空中暗灰。调色：轻柔光溢出、S 曲线、细颗粒（±3%）、柔暗角、轻微闪烁；雾只在局部。只有故事围绕的那个主角的身体或衣服保留颜色（如 #D97757），皮肤和灯光都是灰阶。镜头：长运镜，推向一张脸，再拉远退进雾里。对标摄影师 Arthur Edeson（《卡萨布兰卡》，Michael Curtiz，1942）。避免：平光、整片灰雾、僵硬的胸像。

styles.title: Going My Way
blend_zh: 铅条拼色玻璃 + 灰调描绘
styles.desc_en: Backlit Gothic stained glass: leaded pot-metal pieces with grisaille-painted faces, Chartres blue, ruby borders, and coloured light pooling on the church floor. Father O'Malley's boys' choir is set into the window under a gold star for 'Swinging on a Star'.
styles.desc_zh: 逆光的哥特彩色玻璃：铅条拼起的色玻璃、灰调描出的人脸、沙特尔蓝和宝石红边框，彩光洒在教堂地上。奥马利神父和唱诗班嵌在窗里，头顶是金色星章。
styles.prompt_en: A backlit Gothic stained-glass window filling 80-90% of frame height and ~60% of width, neighbours glowing at edges. Every shape is cut glass: lightness varied ±8% per piece, streaks, seed bubbles, a brown edge mat, black lead (about 1/250 of frame width). Sky and empty ground: diamond quarries (about 1/30 of frame width); the border is ruby with beads. The main figure is at least half the window's height, in dark-brown grisaille line. Palette by role: background cobalt #1B3F9E, border ruby #B3121F, highlights gold #E3A526, lead #16161A; skin pale amber; scenery deep greens. Only the hero the story centres on is orange glass (e.g. #D97757). Bright glass blooms into the leads; coloured light spills onto floor and sill. Camera: tilt down, pan, settle on the pooled light. References: Chartres Cathedral; Harry Clarke. Avoid: flat fills, random cuts, dark empty wall.
styles.prompt_zh: 逆光的哥特彩窗，占画面高度八到九成、宽度约六成，两边露出相邻发光的窗。每个形状是一块切好的玻璃：每块明度浮动约 8%，有流纹气泡和褐色内描边，外压黑铅条（宽约画幅宽 1/250）。天空和空地切成菱形格（每格约画幅宽 1/30）；边框是带圆珠的宝石红。主要人物至少占窗高一半，用尖细的深褐线描脸和衣褶。配色按用途：背景钴蓝 #1B3F9E，边框宝石红 #B3121F，高光金 #E3A526，铅条 #16161A；皮肤淡琥珀；景物用深绿、青绿。只有故事围绕的那个主角是橙色玻璃（如 #D97757）。亮玻璃光晕吃进铅条；彩光落在地面和窗台上。镜头：下摇、横摇，落到光斑上。对标沙特尔大教堂、Harry Clarke。避免：平涂、随意切割、窗四周大片暗墙。

styles.title: The Lost Weekend
blend_zh: John F. Seitz 硬光黑白
styles.desc_en: The picture is typed: monospaced characters on a pica grid, grey built from character density and overstrikes, uneven ribbon ink on bond paper. Don Birnam lugs his typewriter to the pawnshops, so his own machine types the street; Clawd is struck in orange ribbon.
styles.desc_zh: 画面是打出来的：等宽字符落在 pica 网格上，灰阶靠字符疏密和叠打，色带墨色不匀。唐抱着打字机去当铺，于是整条街由打字机打出；Clawd 用橙色色带打。
styles.prompt_en: Type every image: one bold monospaced glyph per keystroke, fixed grid, cells 1/150 of frame width wide, twice as tall. Strike 85-95% of cells; bare paper only for highlights. Grey from a key ladder (light . : -, mid = + o, dark X # M); darks (about 30%) are overstrikes like M#. Shapes read as crisp-edged fields, clear silhouettes. Each material repeats its own keys (e.g. I H verticals, _| courses, ~ water). Signs stay legible. Uneven ribbon: half-inked strikes, a few keys always high or low. Paper #EBE6DA, ink #1D1C21; only the hero the story centres on, at least 1/3 of frame height, is struck in red-orange #D4704F, its shadow black. Hard sidelight casts long, crisp, dense shadows. The picture types itself within the first second, then holds. Reference: Paul Smith's typewriter art. Avoid: sparse frames, shapeless streaks.
styles.prompt_zh: 所有画面都用打字机字符打出来：等宽粗体字逐个敲，落在固定网格上，格宽约画幅宽 1/150、格高是格宽两倍。85%–95% 的格子都要打字，只有最亮的光留纸白。灰阶靠字键分级（浅 . : -，中 = + o，深 X # M），暗部约占三成，用 M# 这样的叠打。形体靠边界清楚的字块和剪影读出。每种材质重复自己的字键（如竖向结构 I H，砖缝 _|，水 ~）。招牌或说明要打得能读。色带墨色不匀：半边缺墨，几个键总是偏高或偏低。纸 #EBE6DA，墨 #1D1C21；只有故事围绕的那个主角用红橙色带 #D4704F 打，至少占画面高度三分之一，影子仍是黑的。硬侧光投出边缘清楚的密集长影。画面在第一秒内打完，然后停住。对标 Paul Smith 的打字机画。避免：稀疏空白、看不出形的横向字条。

styles.title: The Best Years of Our Lives
styles.style_zh: 画报新闻摄影半调跨页
styles.desc_en: A 1946 picture-magazine news photo printed in coarse black halftone on coated stock, with the gutter fold and an overprinted caption. Deep-focus rows of stripped B-17s run to the horizon; Clawd is the only colour, on its own spot-orange plate.
styles.desc_zh: 1946 年画报的新闻摄影跨页：铜版纸上的粗黑网点、中缝折痕、叠印的图片说明。深焦里拆光的 B-17 排到地平线；Clawd 单独印在专色橙版上，是唯一的颜色。
styles.prompt_en: Each frame is a 1946 picture-magazine photo spread. Render the scene as a grey photo (3D or painted): low sun, long shadows, deep focus (near and far both sharp). The photo bleeds across both pages, crossed by a soft vertical gutter crease. Print as a 45° black halftone, dot pitch about 1/250 of frame width, ink #1A1A1A on off-white coated stock #ECE6D8. A short black headline and caption sit in a quiet area. Only the hero the story centres on, at least 1/4 of frame height, prints on its own spot-orange plate (e.g. #D97757) at another angle, 2-3 px off, black only in its deepest shadows. Camera: walk in, push to a detail, pull back to reveal an open magazine. References: cinematographer Gregg Toland; *Life* post-war photo essays. Avoid: the gutter cutting the hero, coarse dots that break the photo.
styles.prompt_zh: 每一帧当成 1946 年画报的新闻摄影跨页。先把场景按照片渲染成灰调（3D 或手绘都行）：低角度太阳、长影子、深焦，近处和地平线一样清楚。照片满版跨过两页，竖向中缝折痕从中间穿过，带一点阴影。再印成 45° 黑色网点，间距约画幅宽 1/250，米白铜版纸 #ECE6D8，墨 #1A1A1A，略有扩墨。从第一镜起，在安静的区域叠印一小块黑色标题和图说。只有故事围绕的那个主角走专色橙版（如 #D97757），换一个网角，错版 2–3 像素，黑版只留在它最深的暗部；主角至少占画面高度四分之一。镜头：走进全景，推进一个细节，再拉远，照片缩成一本摊开的杂志。对标摄影师 Gregg Toland、《生活》杂志战后摄影专题。避免：中缝切过主角，网点粗到照片碎掉。
refs: The Best Years of Our Lives one-sheet (1946)

styles.title: Gentleman's Agreement
styles.desc_en: Graphite pencil in the manner of 1940s magazine illustration: construction lines, near-parallel hatching passes, rubbed darks and eraser lifts on toothy paper. The drawing builds itself around a polite refusal at a hotel desk; Clawd alone is in coloured pencil.
styles.desc_zh: 40 年代杂志插画式的石墨铅笔：先打构图线，再一遍遍平行排线，擦抹暗部、橡皮提亮。画面围绕酒店前台一次客气的拒绝逐步画出，只有 Clawd 是彩色铅笔。
styles.prompt_en: Graphite pencil like a 1940s magazine illustration, finished and controlled. The drawing builds in the first 1-1.5 s, then holds: faint perspective rays and head ovals, pressure-tapered contours (about 1/600 of frame width) overshooting at corners, then 1-4 near-parallel hatching passes (more for darker), about 1/300 of frame width apart, following the form, then rubbed tone and eraser lifts. The finished frame is toned nearly edge to edge: setting fully drawn in mid-greys, about 15% dark accents, only the outer tenth fading to loose margins. Paper #F2EEE5 with a light tooth; lead #2C2B2E. Only the hero the story centres on wears coloured pencil (e.g. #D97757) on its clothing; skin stays graphite. Faces carry the drama. Camera: a slow ease out, then cuts to close-ups. References: illustrators Al Parker and Robert Fawcett. Avoid: cross-hatch grids, scribbly sketching, a near-empty page.
styles.prompt_zh: 用石墨铅笔画成 40 年代杂志插画，画得完整、有控制。画面在前 1–1.5 秒内画成，然后停住：先淡淡的透视线和头部椭圆，再画两头轻中间重、转角出头的轮廓（宽约画幅宽 1/600），然后一到四遍近乎平行的排线（遍数越多越暗），间距约画幅宽 1/300，顺着形体走，再擦抹出平滑的过渡，用橡皮提亮。完成的画面几乎铺满：环境和背景都画充分，以中灰为主，深色约占一成半，只有最外一圈约十分之一淡成没画完的边角。纸 #F2EEE5 带轻齿纹，铅色 #2C2B2E。只有故事围绕的那个主角的衣服用彩铅（如 #D97757），皮肤仍是铅笔灰。戏在脸上。镜头：缓缓拉远，再切特写。对标插画家 Al Parker、Robert Fawcett。避免：交叉网格、潦草速写感、大片空白纸面。

styles.title: Hamlet
blend_zh: Roger Furse 光秃的罗马式布景
styles.desc_en: A real-time 3D Elsinore in high-contrast deep-focus black-and-white: volumetric fog, wet stone, swells breaking into lace foam, silver grain. It follows Olivier's castle, foggy battlements and sea rock; Clawd is the only colour, lifting Yorick's skull.
styles.desc_zh: 实时 3D 的艾尔西诺，高反差深焦黑白：体积雾、湿石头、碎成蕾丝白沫的海浪、银盐颗粒。照奥利维耶片中的城堡、雾中城垛和礁石来拍；Clawd 是唯一的颜色。
styles.prompt_en: A real 3D scene in late-1940s deep-focus black-and-white. Built forms: bare masonry, block by block, bevelled, staggered (Romanesque arches only where the setting has them); wet surfaces dark and glossy. Soft overcast light, no hard shadows: dark masses against a silver sky. Low fog fills the lower third; the far background ends at 60-70% grey, the midground sharp; a bright patch behind cloud throws faint shafts. Water, if any: layered swells, lace foam, misty spray. Post: ambient occlusion, gentle bloom, high-contrast silver grade (true blacks, unclipped whites), grain (±3%), faint flicker. Only the hero the story centres on keeps its colour (e.g. #D97757); every light source stays grey. Camera: slow drift in, a track along a high edge, a low angle on the hero. Reference: Laurence Olivier, *Hamlet* (1948). Avoid: hard sunlit shadows, white-out fog, tiled textures.
styles.prompt_zh: 真 3D 场景，40 年代末的深焦黑白。建筑是裸露的砌体，逐块砌出，带倒角和错缝（场景本有这类建筑时才用罗马式半圆拱）；湿的表面发黑发亮。阴天柔光，没有硬投影：深色实体衬着银灰天空。高度雾贴着画面下三分之一，成片里远景是 60%–70% 灰，中景清晰；云后亮天透出淡淡光柱。有水时：多层涌浪、蕾丝般的白沫、礁石上的水雾。后期：环境光遮蔽、轻辉光、高反差银色调色（有真黑，白不过曝），颗粒 ±3%，轻微闪烁。只有故事围绕的那个主角保留颜色（如 #D97757），所有光源都是灰的。镜头：慢慢漂近，沿高处横移，低机位仰拍主角。对标 Laurence Olivier《哈姆雷特》（1948）。避免：晴天硬影子、雾糊成一片白、贴图平铺。

styles.title: All the King's Men
styles.desc_en: A Southern campaign poster in wood-type letterpress: red, blue and black ink on cream stock, wood grain in the solids, starved patches, misregistered formes and halftone portraits. It is Willie Stark's rally; Clawd is printed in a fourth, orange ink.
styles.desc_zh: 南方竞选海报的木活字凸版：红、蓝、黑三色油墨印在米黄纸上，实地有木纹，供墨不匀，版间错位，肖像走半调网点。这是斯塔克的竞选集会，Clawd 用第四版橙墨印。
styles.prompt_en: A letterpress poster from wood type and cuts. Three inks on cream stock #EEE3C7: blue #20488C (sky, water, shadow masses), red #C82C28 (warm surfaces, stripes), black #1E1B1E (outlines, type); only the hero the story centres on gets a spot ink (e.g. #D97757). Each ink 2-4 px off register; solids knock out the inks beneath, halftones overprint. Wood grain, pinholed starved patches, squeezed edges. Mid tones: coarse dots (about 1/200 of frame width), varied angles, on at most a third of the frame. Figures as linocuts: heavy outlines, gouged white lines, crescent shadows. Picture fills about 70%; short wood-type lines (about 1/10 of frame height, user's language) with offset shadows sit on banners and signs. Camera: small pushes, a lateral track, a bump on each strong beat (or every 2 s). Reference: Hatch Show Print. Avoid: busy grey mid-tones, perfect registration.
styles.prompt_zh: 每帧都是木活字和刻版印的凸版海报。米黄纸 #EEE3C7 上印三色：蓝 #20488C 管天空、水和大块暗部，红 #C82C28 管暖色面和条纹，黑 #1E1B1E 管轮廓和字；只有故事围绕的那个主角多加一块专色（如 #D97757）。每色一版，错位 2–4 像素；实地挖空下层，只有网点处叠印。实地有木纹、缺墨针孔，边缘挤墨。中间调走粗网点（约画幅宽 1/200），各版网角不同，不超过画面三分之一。人物像麻胶版画：粗黑轮廓、刻刀白线、月牙阴影。画面约七成是图；一两行粗木活字短句写在图里的横幅和招牌上，带错位投影，字高约画面十分之一，用用户语言。镜头：小推，横移，重拍上特写一震（无音乐每 2 秒）。对标 Hatch Show Print。避免：碎灰调代替大块实地、套色精准得像电脑。

styles.title: All About Eve
styles.style_zh: 赫希菲尔德一笔画漫画
styles.desc_en: Al Hirschfeld's Broadway caricature: one flowing ink line that swells and tapers, solid blacks against white, lots of empty paper, one exaggerated trait per person. The film is about the theatre, so its party is drawn as a theatre-page cartoon; Clawd is the only colour.
styles.desc_zh: 艾尔·赫希菲尔德的百老汇漫画：粗细变化的流畅墨线、黑块对白、大量留白，每人只抓一个夸张特征。这部片讲剧场，派对就画成报纸剧场版漫画；Clawd 是唯一的颜色。
styles.prompt_en: An Al Hirschfeld-style caricature. Lines are elastic, long and continuous, one stroke per contour: about 1/800 of frame width at the ends, swelling to 1/250 on curves. Dark clothing, hair and big objects go solid black; grey only as sparse parallel hatching. The setting is fully drawn in thin line, architecture, furniture and props in detail, white kept between objects: about 60% paper white, never an empty page. Push one trait per figure (a long neck, a big head). Paper #FBFAF6, ink #131012; only the hero the story centres on has its body or main garment filled flat with one colour (e.g. #D97757) instead of black. Lines write on within the first second, then hold; a short hand-lettered line may sit in the white. Camera: ease back, pan across, push in. Avoid: stiff limbs, stick figures, a bare setting.
styles.prompt_zh: 画成 Al Hirschfeld 式的漫画，白纸黑墨。线条有弹性、长而连贯，能一笔画完的轮廓就一笔：两端约画幅宽 1/800，转弯处加粗到 1/250。深色衣服、头发和大件物体用实心黑块；灰调只用稀疏的平行排线。环境用细线画完整：建筑、家具、道具连同细节都画，物与物之间留白；约六成纸面留白，但绝不是空纸。每个人物靠姿态和比例夸张一个特征（长脖子、大头），五官具体。纸 #FBFAF6，墨 #131012；只有故事围绕的那个主角的身体或主要衣服用一种颜色平涂（如 #D97757），代替黑块。线条在第一秒内一笔笔写完，然后停住；留白处可有一句手写短句。镜头：拉远，横摇扫过场景，小推。避免：四肢僵直、火柴人、空荡荡的环境。

styles.title: An American in Paris
blend_en: Loose ink line over offset colour
blend_zh: 松动墨线 + 错开的色块
styles.desc_en: Raoul Dufy's watercolour: fast blue-black ink lines over big transparent patches of cobalt, lemon and rose that never line up with them. The film's closing ballet was designed after Dufy, so the Place de la Concorde and its dancers are painted his way.
styles.desc_zh: 拉乌尔·杜飞的水彩：快速的蓝黑墨线，底下是钴蓝、柠檬黄、玫瑰红的透明色块，线和色永远对不齐。影片结尾的芭蕾布景就是照杜飞画的，协和广场和舞者都用他的画法。
styles.prompt_en: Paint in Raoul Dufy's watercolour manner: colour first, line second, never aligned. Transparent washes (wet edges, pooled rims, granulation) cover most of the frame, 10-40% oversized, slid one way by about 1/30 of frame width: cobalt #2258CE for sky and water, lemon #FCE02E for light and ground, rose #EC3A7C for warm planes. Overlaps mix violet or green, never brown; keep the hero's wash off blue. Then draw the whole scene densely in quick, thin blue-black ink (about 1/700 of frame width) with flicked ends: buildings, windows, figures, extras; straight edges overshoot corners; trees and clouds as looped strings. Ink #1E1E3A; bare paper 20-30%, skin included. The hero the story centres on gets its own wash (e.g. #D97757). Figures bounce. Camera: small pushes, cuts on the beat (or every 2 s). Avoid: muddy colour, lines tracing the colour, sparse line.
styles.prompt_zh: 用拉乌尔·杜飞的水彩画法：先上色、后画线，两者永远对不齐。透明色块铺满大部分画面，带湿边、积色边和颗粒，比物体大一到四成，朝同一方向滑开约画幅宽 1/30：钴蓝 #2258CE 管天空和水，柠檬黄 #FCE02E 管光和地面，玫瑰红 #EC3A7C 管暖色面。重叠可混出紫或绿，绝不脏成棕，主角的色块别压在蓝上。再用蓝黑墨 #1E1E3A 快速细线把整个场景画满（线宽约画幅宽 1/700），有提按和甩尾：建筑、窗、人物、小配景；直边单独一笔、角上出头；树冠和云画成一串小圈。留白两到三成，皮肤是纸白。故事围绕的那个主角有自己的一块色（如 #D97757）。人物轻快有弹性。镜头：小推，踩拍子切（没有音乐约每 2 秒）。避免：颜色叠脏、线描死色块、线条稀疏。
refs: Preston Ames and Irene Sharaff (ballet design)

styles.title: The Greatest Show on Earth
blend_en: Flat ink with heavy black outline
blend_zh: 平涂油墨 + 粗黑轮廓
styles.desc_en: A Strobridge circus lithograph: flat chrome yellow, vermilion and cobalt with heavy black outlines, screened and slightly off register on grainy stone. DeMille's big top becomes a three-ring poster, with Clawd as the Great Sebastian making the poster's trapeze catch.
styles.desc_zh: Strobridge 马戏团彩色石印：铬黄、朱红、钴蓝平涂，粗黑轮廓，带网点、错版和石版颗粒。德米尔的大帐篷画成三圈海报，Clawd 扮塞巴斯蒂安做空中接人。
styles.prompt_en: A circus chromolithograph after the Strobridge Lithographing Co. (c. 1890). Flat ink, heavy black outlines (about 1/300 of frame width), crescent shadows, light from upper left. Four stones: chrome yellow #F4C416, vermilion #D62C24, cobalt #1E4EA0, key black #181210 on warm cream paper #EBD9B4; overprints and tints give only orange, green, brown, tan, pale blue, grey. Solids print flat; screens (dots about 1/250 of frame width) only on gradients (sky, skin, ground), each stone at its own angle, 1-3 px off register, stone grain. The hero the story centres on is solid yellow under solid vermilion, a flat orange (e.g. #D97757). Exaggerated perspective, radial lines converging on the action, several actions at once; any crowd is tiny individual figures, though a lone figure works. Camera: tilt up, lateral dolly, cut on action. Avoid: off-palette colours, dot-only crowds, a screened, pinkish hero.
styles.prompt_zh: 19 世纪末马戏团彩色石印，仿 Strobridge 石印公司。平涂油墨加粗黑轮廓（约画幅宽 1/300）；阴影是月牙形加深，加排线；光从左上来。四块石版：铬黄 #F4C416、朱红 #D62C24、钴蓝 #1E4EA0、黑 #181210，印在暖奶油纸 #EBD9B4 上；叠印和浅网只能得到橙、绿、棕、土黄、浅蓝、灰。实地平印，只有天空、皮肤、地面这类渐变处挂网（网点约画幅宽 1/250），各版网角不同，错位 1–3 像素，带石版颗粒。故事围绕的那个主角用黄实地叠朱红实地，得到平的橙（如 #D97757）。构图用夸张透视：放射线汇向主要动作，几件事同时发生；有人群时画成许多可辨的小人，只有一个人物也成立。镜头：上摇，横移，在动作中切到高潮。避免：四色以外的颜色、只有圆点的人群、挂网挂成粉色的主角。
refs: The Greatest Show on Earth one-sheet (1952)

styles.title: From Here to Eternity
styles.desc_en: 1953 high-key black-and-white: hard sun, dark filtered sky, blown white foam, wet sand mirroring the sky, silver grain and halation. It stages the kiss in the surf at Halona Cove; Clawd, playing the bugle on the lava rock, is the only colour.
styles.desc_zh: 1953 年的高调黑白：硬朗阳光、压暗的天空、泛白的浪沫、映着天的湿沙，银盐颗粒和光晕。拍哈洛纳海湾浪里那一吻；坐在熔岩上吹军号的 Clawd 是唯一的颜色。
styles.prompt_en: Early-1950s high-key black-and-white photography, painted in 2D to read as a photo: no outlines or flat fills, only soft gradients plus fine texture (sand, rock pitting, cloth). Values: about 70% of the frame above mid-grey; sky light-mid grey, one step below the bright clouds; deep blacks small. Default: hard midday sun, short crisp shadows; under other light keep the pale sky and bright values. Water, foam and mist blow out at the peaks, keeping lace detail; wet surfaces mirror the sky. Print finish: gentle S-curve, slightly soft lens, halation, fresh fine grain (±4%), light vignette, flicker. Only the hero the story centres on keeps colour, whole figure (e.g. #D97757), shaded photographically. Camera: tilt down from the sky, tight level frame, slow pull-back. Reference: cinematographer Burnett Guffey (*From Here to Eternity*). Avoid: low-key frames, white blanks, cartoon fills.
styles.prompt_zh: 50 年代初高调的黑白外景摄影，用 2D 画出照片感：不描线、不平涂，只用柔和渐变加细腻纹理（沙粒、岩石麻点、布纹）。明暗：约七成画面亮于中灰；天空浅中灰，只比亮云暗一档；深黑很少。默认正午硬朗的太阳，影子短而清楚；其他光线下仍保持浅天空和明亮结构。水、浪沫或雾在最亮处冲白，留住蕾丝细节；湿的表面映着天空。按印片收尾：柔和 S 曲线、略软的镜头、高光晕、每帧刷新的细颗粒（±4%）、轻暗角、轻微闪烁。只有故事围绕的那个主角整个人保留颜色（如 #D97757），明暗也有照片感。镜头：从天空下摇，平视紧框，再慢慢拉远。对标摄影师 Burnett Guffey（《乱世忠魂》）。避免：低调暗沉、死白一片、卡通平涂。

styles.title: On the Waterfront
blend_zh: 50 年代美国社会现实主义
styles.desc_en: Ben Shahn's social realism: a trembling, blotted ink line over flat tempera blocks laid slightly off the drawing, big hands and long working faces, restrained slate, brick and ochre. Shahn painted dockers and union halls, which is this film's world.
styles.desc_zh: 本·沙恩的社会现实主义：颤抖的转印墨线，下面是错开的平涂蛋彩色块，大手长脸的工人，颜色克制在灰蓝、砖红、赭黄。沙恩画的就是码头工人和工会，正是这部片的世界。
styles.prompt_en: Ben Shahn's social-realist tempera. Ink lines (about 1/500 of frame width) jitter and wander, break each outline into two or three strokes, sometimes doubled by a fainter offset ghost (a blotted line). Flat tempera blocks sit 2-4 px off the line, rough-edged, dry-brush streaks (one brush wide, about 1/100 of frame width) over a third of each block; model form with a darker flat of the same hue. Palette by role: slate #768492 sky and cool areas, brick #9E4834 and ochre #C89852 ground, buildings, clothes, ink #1F1A1A, warm board #F0E9DA; skin pale ochre; other colours: these darkened or greyed. The hero the story centres on wears the one warm accent on its main garment (e.g. #D97757). Big heads and hands, long faces, heavy jaws, heavy clothes. Camera: short pushes, tilt up, close-up. Avoid: smooth gradients, clean closed outlines, cheerful colour.
styles.prompt_zh: 仿本·沙恩的社会写实蛋彩画。墨线（宽约画幅宽 1/500）会颤：细抖叠着慢摆，一个轮廓分两三笔、不闭合，偶有转印鬼线（旁边多一道偏移的淡线）。颜色是平涂蛋彩块，比墨线偏 2–4 像素，边缘毛糙，每块约三分之一面积带干笔拖痕，拖痕一笔宽（约画幅宽 1/100），不随色块放大；明暗只用同色深一档的硬边平色。配色按用途：灰蓝 #768492 管天空和冷色区，砖红 #9E4834、赭黄 #C89852 管房屋、土地和衣服，墨 #1F1A1A，底板暖白 #F0E9DA；皮肤浅赭；其他颜色由这几色加深或加灰。故事围绕的那个主角的主要衣服用唯一的暖色（如 #D97757）。人物头大手大、长脸重下巴，衣服下垂。镜头：短推，上摇，收在近景。避免：平滑渐变、干净闭合的轮廓、鲜亮讨喜的颜色。

styles.title: Marty
blend_zh: 暖色 50 年代客厅插画
styles.desc_en: A 1955 kinescope playing on a wood-cabinet TV in a warm Bronx living room: scanlines, phosphor glow, a rounded bulging screen, ghosting and snow, all black-and-white except Clawd. Marty began as a live 1953 TV play, so the film is shown as television.
styles.desc_zh: 1955 年的电视录像，在布朗克斯暖色客厅的电视里播：扫描线、荧光晕、圆角凸屏、雪花，只有 Clawd 有颜色。原作是直播电视剧，所以当电视拍。
styles.prompt_en: A 1950s kinescope playing on a wood-cabinet television. Inside the screen: black-and-white with a cool phosphor tint (#DCE6EA whites), soft (half resolution, scaled up), halation, ghosting, tearing bands, a rolling hum bar, light snow, lifted blacks, flicker, grain; only the story's hero keeps its colour (e.g. #D97757), under the same artefacts. Tube: rounded corners, sides bowing outward, about 330 scanlines, glass reflections. Outside, a warm flat-illustrated living room (ochre wallpaper, wood, a table lamp), lit warm by the lamp; the screen casts a clear cold-blue glow on nearby walls. Signature shot: hold about 2 s with the TV filling 60% of the frame, then push through the glass (4-5 s) until the broadcast fills the frame, scanlines visible, then steady TV-studio mid shots. Reference: director Delbert Mann's live Philco Television Playhouse dramas. Avoid: heavy snow, a dull, evenly lit room.
styles.prompt_zh: 把场景做成 50 年代木壳电视里播放的 kinescope 录像。屏幕里：黑白，冷色荧光调（白位约 #DCE6EA），画面发软（半分辨率再放大），有光晕、重影、撕裂带、缓慢滚动的暗带、少量雪花、抬起的黑位、闪烁和颗粒；只有故事围绕的那个主角保留颜色（如 #D97757），同样带这些瑕疵。显像管：圆角、四边外鼓，约 330 条扫描线，玻璃反光。屏幕外是暖色扁平插画风的客厅（赭黄墙纸、木家具、台灯），台灯打暖光，屏幕在附近墙面投出明显的冷蓝光。招牌镜头：电视占画面约六成，先停约 2 秒，再用 4–5 秒推进玻璃，直到节目铺满画面、扫描线还在，然后用演播室式稳定中景拍戏。对标导演 Delbert Mann 的 Philco 电视剧场直播剧。避免：雪花盖住画面、客厅沉闷平光。

styles.title: Around the World in 80 Days
styles.style_zh: 50 年代 UPA 现代主义卡通
styles.desc_en: A flat, geometric 1950s cartoon: colour blocks printed off their ink lines, broken outlines, crayon grain on cream paper. The film's own six-minute end-title animation was made by Saul Bass in this modernist style.
styles.desc_zh: 50 年代平面几何卡通：色块和墨线错位套印、墨线断续、奶油纸上的蜡笔颗粒。本片 6 分钟的片尾动画就出自 Saul Bass，正是这种现代主义画法。
styles.prompt_en: 1950s UPA modernist cartoon. Uneven ink lines #221C19 about 1/400 of frame width, sometimes broken; colour blocks sit about 1/300 of frame width off them, all one way. Objects are overlapping flat cut-out facets: a lit face and a shadow face one flat step (about 15%) darker. Pale aqua sky and cream paper #F2E9D3 cover most of the frame; mustard #E3A92B, teal #2B8C86, orange-red #D4452B are accents; sky, greens and slate blues are these mixed toward paper. Other times of day change only the sky colour. Crayon grain ±5% brightness everywhere, few flecks. Poster layout: one big graphic shape (a building or sun disc), angular outlined figures beside it. Light beams: flat pale wedges. Hard cuts every 1–2 s; slow parallax drift. After UPA, *Gerald McBoing-Boing* (1950); Saul Bass, *Around the World in 80 Days* titles (1956). Avoid: gradients, perfect registration, saturated colour everywhere.
styles.prompt_zh: 50 年代 UPA 现代主义卡通。墨线 #221C19 约画面宽的 1/400，有粗细、偶尔断开；色块相对墨线统一朝一个方向错开约 1/300。物体由重叠的平面剪片拼成：一块受光面，加一块同色深约一成半的平色暗面。明亮通透：浅水绿天空和奶油纸 #F2E9D3 占大半画面，芥末黄 #E3A92B、青绿 #2B8C86、橙红 #D4452B 只作点缀；天空、草绿、灰蓝由这些色兑纸色得到。其他时段只改天空颜色。全画面轻蜡笔颗粒（亮度 ±5%），少量纸白斑点。海报构图：一个大图形（建筑、日轮或山峰），旁边是带轮廓的棱角人物。光束画成浅色平涂楔形。机位之间每一两秒硬切，段内慢视差。对标 UPA《Gerald McBoing-Boing》（1950）、Saul Bass《环游地球八十天》片尾（1956）。避免：渐变、套色太准、饱和色铺满画面。

styles.title: The Bridge on the River Kwai
styles.desc_en: A general-arrangement blueprint pinned to a drafting table: white lines on Prussian blue, folds, water stains, red-pencil revisions. The film is about a colonel obsessed with building a perfect bridge, so the bridge appears as his engineering drawing.
styles.desc_zh: 钉在绘图桌上的总布置图：普鲁士蓝底上的白线、折痕、水渍和红铅笔修改。电影讲一个执意把桥造好的上校，所以把桥画成他的工程图。
styles.prompt_en: Cyanotype engineering blueprint. The sheet fills the frame (the walnut drafting table shows only on a pull-back): mottled Prussian-blue paper #143874, uneven exposure, a greenish over-exposed margin, creases, faint water stains. White lines #ECF4FF, sharp but printed: outlines about 1/600 of frame width, hatching and dimensions half that, broken where exposure was weak, a slight cyan bloom. Draw the subject densely in drafting grammar: elevations, sections, detail circles, dimension chains, hidden lines, single-stroke lettering, a title block. Notes and actions in red pencil #D63426, in the user's language. The one hero subject is the only hand-painted element, drawn above scale (at least 1/5 of frame height), opaque gouache in one warm hue (e.g. orange #D97757); nothing else is warm. Camera: layered parallax push-in; cut to detail views. Avoid: neon glow, clean digital blue, sparse sheets.
styles.prompt_zh: 青晒工程蓝图。图纸铺满画面（胡桃木绘图桌只在拉远时露出）：斑驳的普鲁士蓝纸 #143874，曝光不匀，边缘过曝发绿，有折痕和淡水渍。白线 #ECF4FF 锐利但是印出来的：轮廓约画面宽的 1/600，剖面线和尺寸线减半，曝光弱处断续，带几像素青色微晕。用制图语法把主体画得密：立面、剖面、详图圈、尺寸链、虚线、单线工程字、标题栏。批注和动作用红铅笔 #D63426，写用户的语言。唯一的主角是图上唯一手绘上色的东西，比图纸比例放大（至少占画面高五分之一），不透明水粉，一种暖色分几个深浅（比如橙 #D97757），其余没有暖色。镜头：推近时各层视差，再切详图。避免：霓虹发光、干净的数码蓝、空荡的图纸。

styles.title: Gigi
styles.style_zh: 罗特列克美好年代石印
styles.desc_en: A Toulouse-Lautrec colour lithograph: flat poster colour, dry-brush contours, spattered ink instead of halftone, caricatured faces. Gigi's big moment is walking into Maxim's while all of Paris stares, and Lautrec drew exactly that Paris.
styles.desc_zh: 图卢兹-罗特列克式彩色石印：大块平涂、飞白轮廓、用喷溅墨点代替网点、讽刺漫画式面孔。琪琪的高光时刻是走进马克西姆餐厅、全巴黎回头盯着她，正是罗特列克画过的巴黎。
styles.prompt_en: Belle Époque colour lithograph after Toulouse-Lautrec. Flat colour plates with wobbly edges; figures and main shapes outlined in a loaded brush (blunt start, swelling middle, split dry tail), about 1/250 of frame width. Crachis only on shadow sides, cast shadows and glows: 1–3 px dots at 1920×1080, sparse, under 15% of the frame, a darker step of the colour beneath. Large surfaces get grouped dry-brush streaks. Palette: yellow #F1C232, orange-red #E0602C, olive #6E7036, black #1D1A16 on cream stone-grained paper #EFE3C3, plus a muted bottle teal and greyed mauve; flesh is orange-red thinned with paper. Caricatured profiles with drawn faces; one large figure cropped by the frame edge in front. Flat, even light; shadows are flat plates. Camera: shallow parallax, a slow pan settling on a medium shot. Avoid: Mucha halos, smooth gradients, regular halftone, all-over speckle.
styles.prompt_zh: 罗特列克式美好年代彩色石印。大块平涂色版，边缘略手抖；人物和主要形体用饱蘸的笔刷勾轮廓，起笔钝、中段鼓、收尾分叉飞白，粗约画面宽的 1/250。牙刷弹的墨点只在背光面、投影和光晕处：1920×1080 下点径一到三像素，稀疏，合计不到画面一成半，颜色取底色深一档。大面用成组的同向干笔条纹。色板：黄 #F1C232、橙红 #E0602C、橄榄绿 #6E7036、黑 #1D1A16，底是带石版颗粒的奶油纸 #EFE3C3；另加灰暗的瓶绿和淡紫，肤色是橙红兑纸色。人物是夸张的讽刺侧脸，画出五官；前景放一个被画框裁掉的大人物。光平而匀，阴影也是平涂色版。镜头：浅视差，慢慢横摇过场景，落到中景。避免：慕夏式光环、平滑渐变、规整网点、满屏黑点。
refs: Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec, Moulin Rouge: La Goulue (1891)

styles.title: Ben-Hur
styles.style_zh: 3D 大竞技场战车赛 · 65mm 史诗
styles.desc_en: A fully procedural 3D Circus in widescreen-epic light: hard desert sun, dust, marble and gold, a Technicolor grade and 65mm grain. The chariot race is the film's most famous sequence, so the scene is the race, under the poster's golden colossus.
styles.desc_zh: 程序生成的 3D 大竞技场，宽银幕史诗光感：沙漠烈日、沙尘、大理石和金色，特艺七彩调色加 65mm 颗粒。战车赛是全片最有名的段落，就直接拍比赛，头顶是海报上的金色巨神。
styles.prompt_en: 1959 65mm widescreen epic built in 3D. Default: hard high sun (about 50°), short crisp shadows, cobalt sky fading to sandy white; under a low sun shadows stay hard but long, the sky turns amber. Marble, gilt, red granite and sandstone, with mouldings and fluted columns, never bare boxes. Warm sunlit haze mixes about 20% into mid-distance colours. Technicolor-print grade: warm, saturated, slightly contrasty, no clipping or bloom; fine grain (±3%), slight gate weave. Scale is the point: monumental architecture, statues and repeated elements fill the background, never empty. The one hero subject (e.g. orange #D97757) is the most saturated thing in frame; any repeated motion (stride, wheel, oar) keeps time with speed. Signature shot: low tracking beside the moving hero, 35–50 mm full-frame; then wide, top-down, close-up, low angle. Avoid: clean CG light, empty or primitive sets, overexposure.
styles.prompt_zh: 1959 年 65mm 宽银幕史诗，用 3D 搭。默认是硬朗的高太阳（约 50°），影子短而利，天空钴蓝、到地平线渐成沙白；太阳低时影子仍硬但拉长，天空转琥珀色。大理石、镀金、红花岗岩和沙色石头，做出线脚和槽柱，不能是光秃方盒。暖色尘雾约两成混进中景颜色。调色像 Technicolor 拷贝：暖、饱和、略高反差，不过曝不加辉光；细颗粒（±3%）、轻微片门晃动。核心是规模：背景布满宏伟建筑、雕像和重复元素，绝不空。唯一的主角（比如橙 #D97757）是画面里最饱和的东西；重复动作（步伐、轮、桨）节奏随速度。招牌镜头：全画幅等效 35 到 50mm，低机位贴着运动的主角跟拍；其次是大全景、正俯、近景、仰拍。避免：干净的 CG 光、空荡粗糙的布景、过曝。

styles.title: The Apartment
styles.style_en: Saul Bass Line Titles in Black & White
styles.style_zh: Saul Bass 线条片头 · 黑白
styles.desc_en: Saul Bass's sliding white lines on black build the endless one-point-perspective office of the film's best-known shot, then fill with grey tones. Bass designed this film's titles; the only warm colour is Clawd and its key tag.
styles.desc_zh: Saul Bass 式的白线在黑底上滑入，搭出电影最有名的一点透视无尽办公大厅，再填上灰调。本片片头就是 Bass 做的；全画面唯一的暖色是 Clawd 和钥匙牌。
styles.prompt_en: Saul Bass title lines turned into a set. A shot opens on black: thin white lines (about 1/800 of frame width) slide in and grow into a grid; by 2–3 s grey planes fill in and lights switch on row by row. Then hold the finished frame 3 s: mid-to-light grey, flat fills in 4–5 even steps from #140F0D to #F4F1E8, every shape outlined in dark line about 1/600 of frame width. Strict one-point perspective, centred vanishing point; identical elements repeat into depth (desks and people, or posts, lamps, windows). Figures: flat two-tone shapes. The only warm colour is orange-red #E2472A, for the one hero subject and one prop; all light stays white. Camera: a fast push to the hero, a hard cut to top-down, the grid becoming pattern. Avoid: sketchy lines, gradients, colour leaks, skewed perspective, unfilled wireframe.
styles.prompt_zh: 把 Saul Bass 片头的线条做成布景，黑白加一个暖色。镜头从全黑开始：细白线（约画面宽的 1/800）滑入、向纵深长成网格；两三秒内灰面填满，灯一排排亮起。之后完成态停约三秒：中到浅灰，从 #140F0D 到 #F4F1E8 均匀分四五级平涂，每个形体有约画面宽 1/600 的深色轮廓。严格一点透视，灭点居中；一样的东西重复排向纵深（有人群时是桌子和人，单人时是柱子、路灯、窗格）。人物是两色平涂。唯一的暖色是橙红 #E2472A，只给唯一的主角和一件道具；所有光都是白的。轻颗粒、柔暗角。镜头：急推到主角，硬切到正上方俯视，网格变成图案。避免：草稿感的线、渐变、颜色渗入、透视歪、没填色的暗线框。

styles.title: West Side Story
blend_en: 1961 poster: red sky, black fire escape
styles.desc_en: A saturated, stage-like 3D block of the Upper West Side under a red-orange Technicolor sunset: red brick, zigzag fire escapes, rooftop water towers, posable dancers. It restages the aerial opening, the Jets' snaps and the poster's leap against the red sky.
styles.desc_zh: 红橙特艺七彩晚霞下的上西区 3D 街区，饱和、舞台化：红砖、之字形消防梯、屋顶水塔、能摆姿势的舞者人偶。重演电影的俯拍开场、Jets 打响指和海报上那一跃。
styles.prompt_en: Technicolor 3D stage set, like a 1960s studio musical. Simplified geometry, dense detail on every built surface (openings with sills, ledges, railings, ladders, strung lines); textured brick, plaster or rock, never plain. Theatrical light: a low warm sun rakes surfaces with long shadows; cool fill a quarter of the key. Painted sky of red-orange #E0481E, gold-edged cloud bands, violet only at the top edge; warm haze in the distance. The one hero subject in saturated orange #D97757, at least 1/6 of frame height, set against dark brick or given a black rim so it never melts into the sky. Puppet-like mannequin figures. Warm, saturated grade, fine grain (±3%). Signature shot: a low angle against the orange sky; then one continuous descent into the set and a ground-level push. Avoid: photoreal grime, violet-pink skies, plain walls, poses that pop.
styles.prompt_zh: Technicolor 3D 舞台布景，像 60 年代棚拍歌舞片。几何简化，每个面都细节密集（窗洞窗台、檐口、栏杆、梯子、绳线）；表面是有质感的砖、灰泥或岩石，不能素面。剧场布光：低角度暖阳斜扫表面拉出长影；冷补光约为主光四分之一。手绘天空以橙红 #E0481E 为主，云带镶金边，只在最上沿带一点紫；远处融进暖雾。唯一的主角用饱和橙 #D97757，至少占画面高六分之一，背后衬深色砖墙或加一圈黑边，不能化进天空。人物是木偶式假人。暖而饱和的调色，细颗粒（±3%）。招牌镜头：衬着橙色天空的低角度仰拍；其次一个连续镜头从高处降进布景、再贴地推进。避免：写实脏旧、紫粉天空、素面墙、动作跳变。

styles.title: Lawrence of Arabia
styles.desc_en: Painterly epic-poster gouache with visible directional strokes and a hard warm–cool split: amber sand against cobalt sky. Lawrence of Arabia's original poster was painted by Howard Terpning in exactly this manner.
styles.desc_zh: 看得见笔触方向的史诗海报水粉，冷暖对比强烈：琥珀色沙漠对钴蓝天空。《阿拉伯的劳伦斯》原海报就是 Howard Terpning 用这种画法画的。
styles.prompt_en: 1960s hand-painted epic film poster, gouache with oil highlights. Draw forms solidly, then paint: an opaque mid-tone base, directional strokes following each form (1/80–1/50 of frame width on large areas, smaller on faces and hands), soft-blended edges; model every form in three values; dry-brush only on dust, cloth and distant figures; sharp warm-cream highlights last on lit edges. Warm–cool contrast: cobalt sky #1F4D97 to pale blue #A9C3D6, warming to cream near a low sun; ground #EEC27A (any terrain); ochre-red #B56A33 for skin, earth and costume; violet #6C6394 for distant shadows. The hero centred and largest, a diagonal gesture, cloth streaming; smaller, looser figures may recede behind. Light board grain (±3%), warm vignette, haze. Motion: bounce, slow push to a low close-up, a whip pan out. Avoid: scratchy uniform hatching, flat digital fills, cold-only colour.
styles.prompt_zh: 60 年代手绘史诗电影海报，水粉打底、油彩提亮。先把形体画扎实再上色：铺不透明中间调底色，再用顺形体走的笔触（大面宽约画面宽的 1/80 到 1/50，脸和手用小笔），边缘柔和衔接；每个形体分亮、中、暗三级；干笔只用在尘土、布料和远处人物上；最后在受光边缘压锐利的暖奶油色高光。冷暖对比：钴蓝天空 #1F4D97 过渡到浅蓝 #A9C3D6，低垂的太阳周围转暖；地面 #EEC27A（任何地形），皮肤、泥土和衣服用赭红 #B56A33，远处阴影用紫 #6C6394。主角居中最大，一个斜向动作，布料飘起；身后可以有更小更松的人物退远。轻画板颗粒、暖暗角、雾气。运动：起伏、缓推到仰角近景、甩镜出画。避免：又碎又匀的刮擦线、平涂数码色、只有冷色。

styles.title: Tom Jones
blend_zh: 罗兰森/吉尔雷式手工上色
styles.desc_en: A Georgian satirical print: Hogarth's swelling burin lines and directional hatching under bright Rowlandson-style hand colour brushed slightly off the line, plus a speech balloon. The film itself imitates Hogarth's 18th-century England.
styles.desc_zh: 乔治王时代的讽刺版画：霍加斯式粗细变化的刻线和有方向的排线，上面刷罗兰森式鲜艳的手工淡彩，稍稍出线，再加一个对白气泡。电影本身就在模仿霍加斯笔下的 18 世纪英国。
styles.prompt_en: Georgian satirical print: a copperplate engraving, hand-coloured. Brown-black line only: swelling burin outlines about 1/400 of frame width, heavier on the shadow side; hatching follows each form and covers every surface (spacing about 1/250 of frame width), cross-hatched in the darks, ruled on flat areas. Colour covers nearly the whole picture, clear but strong: washes spilling a few pixels off the line in claret #B3262E, brass #D8A93A, flesh #F0C4A4, slate blue #6D8AA6, warm ochre and umber on large surfaces. Sepia laid paper, foxing, plate mark, engraved border. Stage it like William Hogarth: big-nosed caricatures, bystanders or comic props and animals around the subject; one slanted handwritten speech balloon in the user's language. Camera: hold the full plate 2 s, whip in, glide to another detail, close-up. Avoid: even mechanical hatching, blank paper, colour exactly inside lines, muddy colour.
styles.prompt_zh: 乔治王时代讽刺版画：先刻铜版，印完再手工上色。墨只有棕黑色的线：雕刀轮廓约画面宽的 1/400，起伏鼓胀，背光一侧更粗；排线顺形体走、铺满每个面（线距约画面宽的 1/250），只在暗部交叉，平面用直尺排线。颜色几乎铺满整幅，清透但饱满：水色溢出墨线几像素，用酒红 #B3262E、黄铜 #D8A93A、肉色 #F0C4A4、石板蓝 #6D8AA6，大面用暖赭和棕褐。浅棕褐帘纹纸，淡霉点，版框印痕，刻线边框。按 William Hogarth 的方式布置：大鼻子的漫画人物，主体身边是旁观者或搞笑的道具、动物；一个手写斜体对话气泡，用用户的语言。镜头：全幅停两秒，急推，横滑到另一处细节，再给近景。避免：机械均匀的排线、大片空白纸、颜色严丝合缝填在线里、颜色发脏。
refs: William Hogarth, A Rake's Progress / Marriage A-la-Mode

styles.title: My Fair Lady
blend_zh: Cecil Beaton 阿斯科特服装
styles.desc_en: Fast, dry-edged ink line with pink and magenta watercolour washes, splatter and edges fading to white paper. The original 1964 poster was Bob Peak's ink and pink; the scene is Cecil Beaton's black-and-white Ascot.
styles.desc_zh: 快速、带飞白的墨线，配粉色和品红水彩晕染、甩点，四周化进白纸。1964 年原海报就是 Bob Peak 的墨线加粉彩；场景是 Cecil Beaton 设计的黑白阿斯科特。
styles.prompt_en: 1960s fashion illustration after Bob Peak. Fast ink line, thicker in turns, dry-brush tail, a flick off; 1/600–1/250 of frame width, thinning on tight curves. Solid black for dark clothing, hats and stripes; faces bare paper #FBF7F1. Loose, soft-edged watercolour pools, darker at drying edges: pink #EE84B2 as the main field, magenta #CE3076 for hot spots, rose #F4B2CC, a touch of plum #80285C; warm grey for secondary figures and shading; directional splatter. Settings are a few lines in these washes, not literal colour. The frieze is essential: slender profile figures 9–10 heads tall repeated across the frame (the hero plus grey-wash figures or echoes), black-and-white pattern over pink; washes cover 60–80% of the frame. Camera: slow drift along the figures; graphic-mask transitions. Avoid: even-width outlines, flat digital fills, polygon-edged washes, a lone figure on an empty page.
styles.prompt_zh: 仿 Bob Peak 的 60 年代时装插画。墨线很快：转弯处变粗、直线处变细，后段飞白，收笔一甩；粗细在画面宽的 1/600 到 1/250 之间，小弯处变细。深色衣服、帽子和条纹用实心墨块；脸留白纸 #FBF7F1。水彩是松散柔边的色池，干后边缘积色更深：粉 #EE84B2 做主色，品红 #CE3076 做热点，加玫瑰粉 #F4B2CC 和一点梅紫 #80285C；次要人物和阴影用暖灰；带方向的甩点。场景只用几根线和这几种水彩带过。横排人物是核心：修长侧身，九到十个头高，横向重复（主角加暖灰人物或重影），黑白图案压在粉色上；水彩盖住画面六到八成。镜头：沿人物慢横移；转场借图形遮罩。避免：轮廓粗细一样、平涂数码色、多边形硬边色块、空白页上孤零零一个人。

styles.title: The Sound of Music
styles.style_zh: 绘本感 3D 阿尔卑斯航拍
styles.desc_en: Storybook 3D over procedural Alps: saturated emerald, cobalt and snow white, sculpted ridges, cotton-ball cumulus and gusts running through the grass. It restages the helicopter opening that ends on Maria spinning on the hilltop.
styles.desc_zh: 绘本感的 3D 程序阿尔卑斯：饱和的翠绿、钴蓝、雪白，雕塑感的山脊，棉花团积云，风吹过草地的草浪。重演开场的直升机航拍，最后落到山顶转圈的玛丽亚。
styles.prompt_en: Storybook 3D landscape in saturated 1960s widescreen colour: smooth sculpted forms, not low-poly or photoreal. Default light: bright sun high, a little behind the camera: emerald grass #3FA33A, cobalt sky #2F6FD0, clean white snow and clouds. Rounded ridges, snow lines following slope, grey-ochre rock bands, cloud shadows. Haze only on the farthest ridges, about 25% lilac. Cumulus are lit white cotton puffs. Knee-high grass and wildflowers fill the foreground, bending in gusts. A lower sun lengthens shadows and warms only cloud edges; other settings keep these colours. Camera: one continuous move: 0–2 s high flight, 2–4 s descent, then a low orbit through the grass around the subject (about 20° per second, subject about 1/4 of frame height). References: cinematographer Ted McCord (*The Sound of Music*, 1965); Miyazaki's meadows. Avoid: violet wash, needle peaks, grey photoreal rock, static grass.
styles.prompt_zh: 绘本感的 3D 风景，60 年代宽银幕的饱和色，形体圆润光滑有雕塑感，不写实也不做低多边形。默认光：太阳高挂、略在镜头身后，大地满色：翠绿草地 #3FA33A、钴蓝天空 #2F6FD0、干净的白雪白云。风化山脊圆润，雪线顺坡，岩层暖灰赭，有云影。空气透视只加在最远的山脊，约两成半淡紫。积云是受光的白色棉花团。前景是齐膝密草和野花，随阵风弯伏。太阳低时只拉长影子、让云边变暖；其他场景也用这些颜色。一个连续镜头：前两秒高空飞越，再两秒降到草坡，之后贴草低机位环绕主体（每秒约 20°，主体约占画面高四分之一）。对标摄影师 Ted McCord（《音乐之声》，1965）和宫崎骏的草地。避免：泛紫、针尖山峰、写实灰岩、不动的草。

styles.title: A Man for All Seasons
styles.style_zh: 霍尔拜因都铎肖像油画
blend_zh: 霍尔拜因《托马斯·莫尔爵士像》（1527）
styles.desc_en: An Old Master oil portrait: smooth glazed modelling, fur painted hair by hair, velvet highlights, a gold chain link by link, varnish and craquelure. Holbein painted the real Thomas More in 1527, and this is his composition.
styles.desc_zh: 古典大师油画肖像：平滑罩染塑形、一根根画出的毛领、天鹅绒高光、逐环刻画的金链，再加旧光油和龟裂纹。霍尔拜因 1527 年亲手画过托马斯·莫尔，这里用的就是他的构图。
styles.prompt_en: Oil portrait after Hans Holbein the Younger. Paint in layers: a toned underlayer, directional strokes following light and shadow, soft glazes, fine detail last; smooth finish, brushwork faint in background and fabric. Render each material: fur hair by hair, velvet folds with sharp light ridges, metal with two highlights per piece, wool and leather with soft nap. Any subject becomes a formal half-length sitter in its own clothes; its setting shows through a window or in an object it holds. Palette: deep green curtain #1F4A26, black #141113, velvet red #6E0C15, gold #B0801E, fur brown #3E2818; warm, fully modelled skin. Soft light from upper left. Signature shot: the portrait against the curtain; then material close-ups, a slow pull back into a dark room lit by warm pools. Warm varnish, light craquelure. Avoid: flat fills, hard digital edges, even light, unmodelled faces.
styles.prompt_zh: 仿小汉斯·霍尔拜因的北方文艺复兴油画肖像。一层层画：带色底、顺明暗的笔触、柔和罩染、最后细笔；成品光滑，背景和布料隐约见笔触。每种材质各有画法：毛皮一根根画，天鹅绒褶子亮脊锐利，金属每件两个高光点，呢料和皮革画出柔和绒面。任何主体都画成穿自己衣服的正式半身像；它的场景从窗口露出，或由手里一件东西交代。色板：深绿帘幕 #1F4A26，黑 #141113、天鹅绒红 #6E0C15、金 #B0801E、毛皮棕 #3E2818；皮肤暖色、体积完整。柔光从左上来。招牌镜头：衬着绿帘的半身像；其次是材质特写，再慢慢拉远到暖色光池照亮的暗房间。收尾叠暖色光油和轻龟裂。避免：平涂、数码硬边、均匀亮光、没有体积的脸。
refs: Hans Holbein the Younger, Sir Thomas More (1527)

styles.title: In the Heat of the Night
styles.desc_en: A three-ink Risograph print in deep blue, poster orange-red and fluorescent pink, with halftone, grain and misregistration; light is printed as less ink. It echoes the 1967 poster's orange heat field and black silhouettes.
styles.desc_zh: 三色 Risograph 印刷：深蓝、海报橙红、荧光粉，带网点、颗粒和套色错位；光是用「少上墨」印出来的。呼应 1967 年海报的橙红热浪底和黑色剪影。
styles.prompt_en: Three-ink Risograph: orange-red #EC5032 as the dominant field (about 60%, with drip streaks), deep blue #162C76 for silhouettes and shadows, fluorescent pink #FF48B0 only for rims and halos, on warm paper #F7F2E7. Each ink is halftoned at its own angle, dots 1/300 of frame width, plates misregistered 2–4 px; grain, pinholes, slight boil. Knock orange out under blue silhouettes so they print pure blue; only the darkest accents overprint to near-black. Light is the absence of ink: beams, lamps and lit ground show bare paper, ringed in pink. Figures: blue silhouettes, pink rims; skin is 30–60% orange with a blue shadow step. At cooler times keep the red field; blue rises only into the top of the sky. Camera: handheld behind someone carrying a light, a reverse close-up, a push. Avoid: blue-dominated frames, smooth gradients, a fourth ink, clean registration.
styles.prompt_zh: 三色专色 Risograph 印刷：橙红 #EC5032 是主场（约占画面六成，带竖向流淌痕），深蓝 #162C76 给剪影和阴影，荧光粉 #FF48B0 只给轮廓光和光晕，印在暖白纸 #F7F2E7 上。每色是各自网角的半调，点径约画面宽的 1/300，版间错位二到四像素；有墨粒、针孔，逐帧轻微抖动。蓝剪影底下挖掉橙色，印成纯蓝；只有最暗处两色叠成近黑。光就是没有墨：光束、灯和被照亮的地面露出纸白，外圈一道粉。人物是带粉色边缘光的蓝剪影，肤色用三到六成橙色网点加一级蓝暗部。时间偏冷时仍保留红场，只让蓝色升到天空顶部。镜头：手持跟在提着光源的人身后，一个反打近景，一次缓推。避免：蓝色占满画面、平滑渐变、第四种墨、套印太准。

styles.title: Oliver!
styles.desc_en: A Victorian toy theatre: hand-coloured lithographed card figures with a white scissor margin, layered flats on wire slides, a gilt proscenium and flickering candle footlights throwing shadows up the scenery. Oliver! is a musical, staged here on the Victorian home stage.
styles.desc_zh: 维多利亚玩具纸剧场：手工上色的石印卡纸人物留着剪刀白边，景片分层插在滑杆上，镀金台口下的烛光脚灯把影子投上景片。《雾都孤儿》是歌舞片，正好搬上维多利亚家庭小舞台。
styles.prompt_en: Victorian toy paper theatre (Pollock's), all printed card: black lithographic outlines about 1/400 of frame width, sparse crayon hatching on one side of each piece; muted antique hand colouring: deep red #C8262C and dull gold #E0AB36 on proscenium and curtains (never bright yellow), blue #2F5A9A for costumes; scenery, sky, water and skin in greyed browns, greys and cream card #F4ECD6. Every cut-out keeps a white scissor margin (1/200 of frame width). Flats are parallel 2.5D layers in parallax, flat within each plane. Candle footlights throw each cut-out's shadow onto the scenery behind, about 1.5× enlarged, soft, flickering. Gilt proscenium, red drapes and painted audience boxes frame a stage opening 80–90% of frame width. Camera: slow push, lateral tracking, shaky close-ups; a final pull-back shows the dark room. Avoid: bright vector colour, true 3D depth, soft studio light, figures without margins.
styles.prompt_zh: 维多利亚玩具纸剧场（Pollock's 式）。一切都是印出来的卡纸：黑色石印轮廓约画面宽的 1/400，每张剪纸一侧有稀疏蜡笔排线；手工上色是沉稳旧色：深红 #C8262C 和暗金 #E0AB36 用在台口和帷幔（金色不能是亮黄），蓝 #2F5A9A 给服装；布景、天空、水和肤色用发灰的棕、灰和奶油卡纸 #F4ECD6。每个人物和景片留一圈剪刀白边（约画面宽的 1/200）。景片是平行的 2.5D 层，层间视差，层内无透视。烛光脚灯把剪纸影子放大约一倍半投到后面景片上，柔边，随烛火闪动。镀金台口、红帷幔和画出来的包厢观众框住舞台，台口宽占画面八到九成。镜头：慢推、横移，近景微震；结尾拉远露出暗房间。避免：鲜艳矢量色、真 3D 纵深、柔和摄影光、没有剪边的人物。

styles.title: Midnight Cowboy
styles.style_zh: 沃霍尔照片丝网 · Double Elvis
styles.desc_en: Warhol's photo-silkscreen: a black halftone photo printed unevenly over loose flat colour blocks on silver, the image repeated two and three times. The film has a Factory-style party in it, and his Elvis is a cowboy.
styles.desc_zh: 沃霍尔的照片丝网：黑色网点照片层印得不匀，错位地压在松散的平涂色块上，底是银色，画面重复两次、三次。片里就有沃霍尔工厂式的派对，而他画的猫王正是牛仔。
styles.prompt_en: Andy Warhol photo-silkscreen. Two plates: a high-contrast black halftone photograph at 45°, dots about 1/200 of frame width, few mid-tones; and hand-painted flat colour blocks underneath, offset about 1/100 of frame width with wobbly edges: taxi yellow #F3BE14, skin pink #F2A197, cream #EFE6CF, red #E2462B, on brushed silver paint #BABCC0 with a soft sheen. The one hero subject takes the strongest block colour. Uneven squeegee pressure: dots flood into blotches in places, drag into dry horizontal streaks and pinholes elsewhere, over faint canvas weave. Repetition is the composition: the same figure or object, full-length, printed side by side two then three times, slightly overlapping, on empty silver. Settings appear only as drained-to-silver prints in the repeat. Camera: handheld shake, a push in, flat frontal tableaux. Reference: Andy Warhol, *Double Elvis* (1963). Avoid: clean even halftone, perfect registration, uniform crispness.
styles.prompt_zh: 安迪·沃霍尔式照片丝网印。两块版：一块是 45° 的高反差黑色半调照片，网点约画面宽的 1/200，几乎没有中间调；下面是手刷平涂色块，相对照片错开约画面宽的 1/100，边缘歪扭：出租车黄 #F3BE14、肤粉 #F2A197、奶油 #EFE6CF、红 #E2462B，底是带柔和光泽的刷涂银漆 #BABCC0。唯一的主角用最强的那块颜色。刮板压力不匀：有的地方网点糊成墨团，有的地方拖成横向干笔条纹和针孔，底下隐约有画布纹。重复就是构图：同一个人物或物体全身，在空银底上并排印两次、再印三次，略有重叠。场景只以褪成银色的印样出现在重复里。镜头：手持晃动、推近、正面平面定格。对标沃霍尔《Double Elvis》（1963）。避免：干净均匀的网点、套色完全对齐、处处一样清晰。
refs: Andy Warhol, Silver Car Crash (Double Disaster) (1963)

styles.title: Patton
styles.style_zh: 二战战争债券石印海报
blend_zh: 1942–45 美军征兵与战争债券海报
styles.desc_en: Flat-colour stone lithograph in the manner of 1940s US war-bond posters: posterised folds, a dark key line, halftone shadows, yellowed stock. It fits Patton's opening speech, where a tiny general stands before a stage-high flag.
styles.desc_zh: 仿 1940 年代美军战争债券海报的石印画法：分级平涂的褶皱、深色轮廓、网点阴影、泛黄的纸。对应《巴顿将军》开场：小小的将军站在一面占满舞台的巨幅国旗前训话。
styles.prompt_en: 1940s US war-bond lithograph poster. Flat inks: red #C2342C, navy #213261, olive #5F5C31, khaki #B7975E, on fibrous, foxed cream #E6D5B3 paper. Three values per form (bare paper, flat ink, ink plus halftone), posterised in hard steps. Brown-black key line about 1/500 of frame width, printed last; shadows as coarse 45° halftone bands (dots about 1/150 of frame width) with crayon grain; colour plates offset about 1/600 of frame width. Default: a symmetrical frontal stage, a small subject before a huge graphic shape filling most of the frame (flag, emblem, sunburst), lights as hard pale shapes or bare paper; outdoors too, light falling as a hard pale pool. Lettering optional, in the user's language. Camera: slow push-ins, one crisp pull-back. Reference: US war-bond posters, 1942–45. Avoid: airbrushed gradients, perfect registration, halftone so fine it reads grey.
styles.prompt_zh: 1940 年代美国战争债券石印海报。平涂油墨：红 #C2342C、海军蓝 #213261、橄榄绿 #5F5C31、卡其 #B7975E，印在米白 #E6D5B3 的纸上，有纤维、霉点和磨边。每个形体三档：留纸、平涂、油墨加网点，压成硬边色阶。棕黑轮廓线约画面宽的 1/500，最后压上；阴影是粗的 45° 网点带（点径约画面宽的 1/150），带蜡笔颗粒；色版错开约画面宽的 1/600。默认像舞台：对称正面，小主体站在占满大半画面的巨大图形前（旗帜、徽章、放射光芒），灯光是硬边浅色块或留纸；户外也一样，光落成地上的硬边浅斑。文字可有可无，用用户的语言。镜头慢推，配一次干脆的拉出。对标 1942–45 年美国战争债券海报。避免：喷枪渐变、套色完全对齐、网点细到像一片灰。

styles.title: The French Connection
styles.style_zh: 高架铁下追车 · 16mm 颗粒 3D
blend_zh: 暗部偏青的冷灰印片调色
styles.desc_en: A full 3D Brooklyn avenue under the elevated railway, graded like grainy 16mm: cold grey, cyan shadows, high contrast, gate weave. The film is remembered for its car chase under the el, and only a real 3D world gives that speed.
styles.desc_zh: 整条布鲁克林高架铁下的大街用 3D 建出来，再调成粗颗粒 16mm：冷灰、暗部偏青、高反差、片门抖动。这部片最有名的就是高架铁下的追车，3D 才拍得出那种速度。
styles.prompt_en: Gritty early-1970s documentary look in a detailed 3D world, finished as pushed 16mm. Grade: low saturation, high contrast; neutral-cold greys #7A7C7A, cyan shadows #1E2A2C, warm-brown mid-tones #6E4A34 in brick, wood, vehicles (at least a quarter of the frame), never an overall blue; the one hero (e.g. #D97757) stays saturated. Default overcast, sky near-white, at any time of day; sun through any overhead grid (track, bridge, pier) falls in hard stripes. Grain clumps about 1/700 of frame width, ±8% brightness; gate weave, flicker, dust, occasional faint ghosts of bright lights. Dense clutter fitting the place. Handheld cameras ride the action: a low 18–25 mm lens rushing forward as repeated objects strobe past, a rig looking back at the subject, a corner wide. References: William Friedkin, *The French Connection* (1971); cinematographer Owen Roizman. Avoid: clean CG shine, blue tint, empty places, mushy grain.
styles.prompt_zh: 70 年代初粗粝的纪实感，放在细致的 3D 世界里，按增感冲洗的 16mm 收尾。调色：低饱和、高反差；中性冷灰 #7A7C7A、带青的暗部 #1E2A2C，砖、木头、车辆保持暖棕 #6E4A34，至少占四分之一画面，绝不整体泛蓝；唯一的主角（比如橙 #D97757）保持饱和。默认阴天，天空亮到近白，任何时段都一样；阳光穿过头顶格栅（轨道、桥、栈桥）落成硬边条纹。颗粒成团，约画面宽的 1/700，亮度 ±8%；片门晃动、闪烁、灰尘，亮处偶有淡重影。杂物多且符合地点。手持机位跟着动作走：18 到 25mm 低机位向前冲，重复物体频闪掠过；回看主体的跟拍机位；墙角广角。对标 William Friedkin《法国贩毒网》（1971）和摄影师 Owen Roizman。避免：干净的 CG 反光、整体泛蓝、空荡的方块场景、颗粒糊成一片。

styles.title: The Godfather
blend_zh: 伦勃朗、卡拉瓦乔式罩染
styles.desc_en: Oil painting in deep amber and umber where only the top light is warm: thin transparent glazes in the darks, thick impasto on the lit edges. It recreates Gordon Willis's overhead light in the 'I believe in America' study.
styles.desc_zh: 深琥珀和赭褐的油画，只有顶光落下的地方是暖的：暗部是透明的薄罩染，受光边缘是厚涂。重现戈登·威利斯在“I believe in America”那间书房里的顶光。
styles.prompt_en: Chiaroscuro oil painting after Rembrandt and Caravaggio, one overhead light. About 70% of the frame is readable warm dark, mostly umber #24150B, near-black #070403 only in the deepest corners. Amber #8F5D2A mid-tones about 20%; top planes reach #E2B673. The hero stands in the light pool, lit area at least 1/4 of frame height; brows shade the eyes. One red accent #9C1A1A. Darks thin smooth glazes; lights thick impasto, ridged strokes about 1/100 of frame width; modelling soft, never scratchy. Amber varnish, heavy vignette, canvas grain (±3%). A warm bright opening (window, doorway, horizon) may glow behind; a small lamp in frame is a small glow, not a second key. Camera: slow pull-backs and pushes. Reference: Francis Ford Coppola, *The Godfather* (1972), cinematographer Gordon Willis. Avoid: lifting the darks, flat light, faces popping out, frames too dark to read.
styles.prompt_zh: 伦勃朗、卡拉瓦乔式明暗油画，只有一盏顶光。约七成画面是看得出形体的暖暗部，大多是赭褐 #24150B，近黑 #070403 只在最深的角落。琥珀 #8F5D2A 中间调约两成；朝上的面亮到 #E2B673。主角整个站在光池里，受光部分至少占画面高的四分之一；眉骨把眼睛压进阴影。一处饱和的红 #9C1A1A。暗部薄而平滑地罩染，亮部是带亮笔脊的厚涂，笔触约画面宽的 1/100；过渡柔和，不用刮擦线条。琥珀光油，重暗角，细画布纹（±3%）。背景可有一处暖色亮口（窗、门洞、发亮的天边）；画内的小灯只是一小团光，不算第二个主光。镜头慢拉、慢推。对标 Francis Ford Coppola《教父》（1972），摄影师 Gordon Willis。避免：提亮暗部、平光、人脸跳出来、暗到看不清。
refs: S. Neil Fujita, The Godfather poster logo

styles.title: The Sting
styles.desc_en: Warm, clean magazine illustration in the Leyendecker–Rockwell line: blocky lit planes, parallel strokes, crisp dark contours. The Sting's own chapter cards imitate Saturday Evening Post covers, so its 1936 betting parlour is drawn the same way.
styles.desc_zh: Leyendecker、Rockwell 一路的杂志插画：块面受光、平行笔触、利落的深色轮廓。片中章节卡就仿《星期六晚邮报》封面，1936 年的下注厅也照这个画。
styles.prompt_en: 1930s Saturday Evening Post cover illustration. Realist figures, correct proportions, expressive faces, built from blocky planes (lit, shadow, warm bounce from below) filled with blended strokes about 1/150 of frame width, varied in length, following the form, never stripes. Dark contour thicker on the shadow side, 1/800–1/300 of frame width. Warm key from upper left. Palette: plaster #E2C492, oak #764626, slate #28322C, brass #E2B046, ink #341E18; oak and ink darks about a third of the frame; sky plaster cooled with slate, water light slate, skin plaster plus brass. Grainy board (±3%), warm vignette. Default one-point perspective, period detail, haze, secondary figures if the story has any. Each figure is drawn once and moves whole (breathing, sway, sliding along a path). Camera: one long, smooth push in. References: J. C. Leyendecker, Norman Rockwell. Avoid: stiff cut-out figures, even outlines, muddy colour.
styles.prompt_zh: 30 年代《星期六晚邮报》封面插画。写实人物，比例准确、表情生动，用块面塑造（受光、背光、下方暖色反光），块面里填顺着形体、长短不一的笔触，宽约画面宽的 1/150，柔和衔接，不成条纹。深色轮廓在背光一侧加粗，画面宽的 1/800 到 1/300。暖色主光从左上来。配色：灰泥 #E2C492、橡木 #764626、石板 #28322C、黄铜 #E2B046、墨 #341E18；橡木和墨色暗部约占三分之一画面；天空灰泥偏石板，水是浅石板，皮肤灰泥加黄铜。轻颗粒画板（±3%）加暖暗角。默认一点透视，时代细节，薄雾，故事有就加次要人物。每个人物只画一遍，整体移动（呼吸、摇摆、沿路径滑行）。镜头：一次长而平滑的推进。对标 J. C. Leyendecker、Norman Rockwell。避免：僵硬剪纸人物、粗细一样的轮廓、发脏的颜色。

styles.title: The Godfather Part II
blend_zh: Lewis Hine 的埃利斯岛照片
styles.desc_en: A turn-of-the-century toned silver print with dyes brushed on by hand: sepia, soft lens, silver grain, foxing, a cracked corner, faint red, blue and verdigris. It shows young Vito arriving at Ellis Island in 1901, as in Lewis Hine's photographs.
styles.desc_zh: 世纪之交的调色银盐照片，手工刷色：棕褐调、柔焦、银盐颗粒、霉斑、裂角，局部淡淡的红、蓝、铜绿。画的是 1901 年少年维托抵达埃利斯岛，像 Lewis Hine 的照片。
styles.prompt_en: A hand-coloured toned silver print from about 1900. Build lit 3D forms, soft key from upper left, then 'print' them: soft focus, light halation, grain heaviest in mid-tones (±5%), full sepia range #281A12, #987048, #EEE0C2; at least a fifth of the frame reaches the dark end, in any light. Figures: real proportions (head 1/7 of body), soft shading. Transparent dyes brushed loosely past edges: the one hero subject strongly (e.g. orange-red #D97757 at 60–80% opacity), a faint touch on one or two props; dyes die in shadow. Light ageing: vignette, silvered edges (grey-blue sheen in border darks), small foxing spots, fine scratches, at most one cracked corner. Frontal, documentary: figures stand still facing the lens. Camera: slow pan across faces. References: Lewis Hine; Augustus Sherman (Ellis Island). Avoid: toy figures, digital fill colour, low-contrast fog, big mould blotches.
styles.prompt_zh: 1900 年前后手工上色的棕褐银盐照片。先做受光的立体形体，柔光从左上来，再“印”出来：柔焦带轻微光晕，颗粒在中间调最重（±5%）；棕褐调从 #281A12 经 #987048 到 #EEE0C2 完整铺开，至少五分之一画面落到最深一端，任何光线下都一样。人物比例真实（头约七分之一身高），明暗柔和。透明颜料松松地刷，溢出边缘：唯一的主角最重（比如橙红 #D97757，不透明度六到八成），一两件道具轻点；颜色进暗部就被吞掉。做旧要轻：暗角、边缘银化（靠边暗部泛灰蓝金属光）、几个小霉点、细划痕，最多一个裂角。构图正面、纪实，人物静立面对镜头。镜头缓慢横摇扫过人脸。对标 Lewis Hine、Augustus Sherman 的埃利斯岛照片。避免：积木人物、数码填色、低反差雾灰、大片霉斑。
refs: Francis Ford Coppola, The Godfather Part II (1974)

styles.title: One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest
blend_en: flat oil planes with dragged strokes
