refs: New Bedford Whaling Museum scrimshaw collection

styles.title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
styles.style_zh: 光线步进多元宇宙跳切
blend_en: One look per universe (office realism, cosmic surreal, landscape, commercial)
blend_zh: GLSL 光线步进的多个宇宙
一个宇宙一种画法（写实办公室、超现实宇宙、风景、广告）
styles.desc_en: Four universes, each with its own look, all ray-marched in real time: a cold-green IRS office, a hot-dog-finger piano lit like an advert, a silent canyon of googly-eyed rocks, the Everything Bagel as a black hole. A googly eye jumps between them.
styles.desc_zh: 四个宇宙四种画法，全部实时光线步进：冷绿的国税局、广告光下的热狗手指钢琴、贴大眼睛石头的寂静峡谷、变成黑洞的万物贝果。像电影里一样，靠大眼睛贴纸在宇宙间跳转。
styles.prompt_en: Ray-marched real-time 3D multiverse montage: the subject jumps through 3–4 universes, each its own look, invented from its world, e.g. a realistic workplace under cold green fluorescents, densely dressed; a surreal cosmic version with a gravitational-lens halo; a silent wide landscape with white subtitles; a candy-pink product shot with pink-and-cyan rims. Each holds 2–4 s with its own grade. One link through all: a googly-eye sticker on the subject, about 1/10 of frame height. Transition, 0.5–0.8 s: push into the eye, smear, split RGB, then a rainbow ring of colour segments (#e5322d, #f7c928, #1fa39a, #2a6fc0, #e0478f) studded with googly eyes and pink beads blooms to ~80% of frame height and bursts to white. Signature frame: the ring around the subject; first jump at ~1 s. Reference: Daniels, *Everything Everywhere All at Once* (2022). Avoid: look-alike universes, a small plain ring.
styles.prompt_zh: 实时光线步进 3D 的多元宇宙蒙太奇：主体在三到四个宇宙之间跳转，各有画法，都从主体自己的世界变出来，例如：冷绿日光灯下的写实工作场所，陈设很满；带引力透镜光环的超现实宇宙；配白字幕的安静旷野远景；糖果粉背景、粉青轮廓光的广告产品照。每个停 2–4 秒，各自调色。贯穿始终的衔接物：主体身上的一只活动眼贴纸，约占画高十分之一。跳转 0.5–0.8 秒：推进这只眼睛，拖影、RGB 分离，再炸开一圈彩虹色块环（#e5322d、#f7c928、#1fa39a、#2a6fc0、#e0478f），环上嵌满活动眼和粉珠，扩到画高约八成后白闪。招牌画面：彩虹环围着主体绽开；第一次跳转在 1 秒左右。参照丹尼尔斯兄弟《瞬息全宇宙》（2022）。避免：宇宙都一个样、环太小太素。
refs: Daniels, Everything Everywhere All at Once (2022)

styles.title: Oppenheimer
styles.style_zh: 3D 粒子火球 · IMAX 颗粒
blend_zh: 三位一体试验高速照片
styles.desc_en: The Trinity test site before dawn rebuilt in real-time 3D, with a fireball of about 720,000 particles, quantum visions of orbits and waves, deep pre-dawn blue against orange-gold fire and IMAX-style grain. Oppenheimer is built on that one light.
styles.desc_zh: 用实时 3D 重建黎明前的三位一体试验场：约 72 万粒子的火球、轨道和波组成的量子幻象，深蓝夜色对橙金火光，加 IMAX 式颗粒。《奥本海默》就围着这一道光展开。
styles.prompt_en: Real-time 3D night lit by one huge particle event: a ~500k-particle fireball (or flare, eruption, wildfire) whose shape follows time: white flash (0.5 s), billowing dome by 1 s, a rolling toroid, a dust wall sweeping out. Right behind the subject like a halo, ~40% of the frame: white-gold core, bright orange-gold billows #ff9a50 with visible texture, black smoke only as thin veins and the top edge (under 15%). Its glow fills everything: warm #ffd8a0 on ground and cloud undersides, a hot rim on the subject, faces lit warm at half strength; long shadows toward camera. The rest is pre-dawn blue #2a3654 and dark earth #16120e. Clip only the core. IMAX grade: grain ±3%, warm halation, vignette, slight gate weave. Low wide angle, subject centred, slow push-ins. Reference: Christopher Nolan, *Oppenheimer* (2023). Avoid: a smooth CG ball, smoke-shrouded fire.
styles.prompt_zh: 实时 3D 夜景，主角光是一场巨大的粒子事件：几十万粒子的火球（或照明弹、火山喷发、山火），形状随时间走：白闪（0.5 秒），1 秒成翻滚的斑驳穹顶，再卷成环，尘墙外扫。在主体正后方像光环，约占画面四成：核心白金，大部分是有纹理的亮橙金火团 #ff9a50，黑烟只做细暗纹和顶边，不超一成半。火光照亮全场：暖色 #ffd8a0 铺满地面和云底，主体有热轮廓光，脸上仍有半强度暖光；长影子朝镜头拖来，火星飘飞。其余是黎明前的深蓝 #2a3654 和暗土 #16120e。只让核心过曝。IMAX 拷贝调色：细颗粒（±3%）、暖色光晕溢出、暗角、轻微片门晃动。低机位广角，主体居中，慢推。参照克里斯托弗·诺兰《奥本海默》（2023）。避免：光滑的 CG 光球、被黑烟裹住的火。

styles.title: Anora
styles.desc_en: Glowing neon tubes in pink, cyan and orange, smeared into wet boardwalk planks and caught in falling snow, with bloom, bokeh and grain. Anora runs from Brighton Beach's Cyrillic neon to a Vegas wedding sign, so the whole segment is lit by tubes.
styles.desc_zh: 粉、青、橙的霓虹灯管发着光，倒影拖在湿栈道上，落进飘雪里，加上辉光、虚焦光斑和颗粒。《阿诺拉》从布莱顿海滩的俄文霓虹走到维加斯的婚礼招牌，整段都用灯管照亮。
styles.prompt_en: Photographic 2D neon night. Real tubes: glass tube, glow, bright tube, white-hot core, clips, dark jumper wires; rare flicker (every 5–10 s). Neon pink #ff4fa8, cyan #4fdcff, orange #ff9a2e, green #3dff9a plus warm sodium light over a deep purple-blue night #1e1838. Put neon where the subject's world allows (shopfronts, a harbour bar, its own building). Wet ground fills the lower quarter: signs stretch into long vertical reflections broken by plank gaps, paving joints or ripples; snow falls and drifts at the edges, tinted by the spill. The subject keeps a warm key on the face (a lamp, a window, its own light), narrow neon rims on both sides; the distance melts into bokeh. Bloom, vignette, grain ±3%. Short 2–3 s shots, new angles on one place, each a slow push-in. Reference: Sean Baker, *Anora* (2024). Avoid: flat neon lettering, strobing.
styles.prompt_zh: 照片感的 2D 霓虹夜景。招牌是真实灯管：玻璃管、辉光、亮管、白热管芯，带卡子和深色跳线；轻微起伏，很少抖一下（5–10 秒一次）。粉 #ff4fa8、青 #4fdcff、橙 #ff9a2e、绿 #3dff9a，加暖色钠灯，压在深紫蓝夜色 #1e1838 上。霓虹放在主体世界里说得通的地方（店面、港口酒吧、主体自己那栋楼）。画面下四分之一留给湿地面：招牌拉成长长的竖向倒影，被木板缝、地砖缝或水纹打断；雪在下，边上积成雪堆，被溢光染色。主体脸上保留暖色主光（来自近处的灯、窗或它自己的灯），两侧各一条窄霓虹轮廓光；远处虚成光斑。辉光、暗角、颗粒（±3%）。每个短镜头 2–3 秒，同一地点换角度，各自慢推。参照肖恩·贝克《阿诺拉》（2024）。避免：平涂彩字式霓虹、干地面、频闪。

styles.title: One Battle After Another
styles.style_zh: 3D 起伏公路追车 · 长焦压缩
styles.desc_en: A real-time 3D desert road that rises and falls like a roller coaster, three cars chasing over the dips, shot through extreme long lenses with heat haze, bleached sunlight and fine grain. It rebuilds the film's best-known sequence, the dip-road chase.
styles.desc_zh: 实时 3D 的沙漠公路，像过山车一样一起一伏，三辆车翻着一道道坡追逐，用超长焦拍，带热浪、漂白的强光和细颗粒。复刻的是这部片最有名的段落：起伏公路追车。
styles.prompt_en: Real-time 3D, bleached desert daylight. Signature shot (3–5 s): a straight road over rolling dips and crests at a 2–5° horizontal field of view, stacking dips into waves; the travelling subject sinks and reappears; sky a thin band at most. Then 1–2 s each, a low camera at a crest, a mount on the vehicle or rider. Palette: sky #7fb0e0, haze #ece4d2 only at the far horizon, pale sand #d2ae80 (never orange), hard sun #fff0d8 from high to one side, the main vehicle faded seafoam #86b5ad. Contrast: dark cracked asphalt, crisp shadows, dense green scrub, roadside posts. Default midday; at other hours keep hard sun. Heat shimmer and mirage grow with distance; dust on landings; vehicles leave the ground over crests. Grain ±2%. Reference: Paul Thomas Anderson, *One Battle After Another* (2025). Avoid: wide lenses, a washed-out frame.
styles.prompt_zh: 实时 3D，漂白般的沙漠日光。招牌镜头（3–5 秒）：一条笔直的路在连续起伏的坡谷上，水平视角 2–5°，让坡谷叠成波浪，行进的主体沉下去又冒出来；构图先保坡谷，天空最多留一条窄带。再接各 1–2 秒的坡顶低机位、车载或骑手机位。配色：天空 #7fb0e0，雾气 #ece4d2 只在最远的地平线，浅沙色 #d2ae80（不能发橙），硬朗阳光 #fff0d8 从高处侧打，主车是褪色海沫绿 #86b5ad。反差来自前景：开裂的深色沥青、清晰阴影、茂密的绿灌木、路边桩。默认正午，其他时段也保持硬光。热浪扭曲和路面蜃景随距离加重；落地扬尘；车过坡顶腾空、落地弹跳。大画幅细颗粒（±2%）。参照保罗·托马斯·安德森《一战再战》（2025）。避免：广角、发白发灰的画面、粘在路上的车。
refs: Paul Thomas Anderson, One Battle After Another (2025)
